N’ajja n’ategeeza nnabbi Erisa ekyabaddewo. “Genda otunde amafuta ago,” n’amugamba, “osasule amabanja go, ebinaafikkawo bikuliisenga ggwe ne batabani bo obulamu bwammwe bwonna.” Embeera yali ya kabi nnyo eri nnamwandu ono. Teyalaba kkubo lya kuvaamu mu kizibu kye, kubanga embeera zaali zimuzitoowerera. Kye yalaba kyokka kyali kizikiza ekitaliimu ssuubi. Kyalabika nga tewali kkubo lya kuva mu kiwonvu kye. Yali yeetaaga OKWOLESEBWA okuggya Abasajja babiri mu kasenge k’ekkomera, nga batunuulira mu byuma Omu yalaba kizikiza kyokka, omulala n’alaba emmunyeenye! Abasajja bombi baalina ekifaananyi kye kimu mu maaso gaabwe, naye okwolesebwa kwabwe kwali kwa njawulo! Embeera zaabwe zaali zimu, naye endowooza zaabwe zaali za njawulo. Omutima gwa nnamwandu gwali guzitowa, ng’anaatera okufiirwa batabani be bombi eri abaali bamubanja. Yali asitudde omugugu ogwamuzitoowerera. Yali yeetaaga OMUGUGU ogw’enjawulo Omulenzi yalabibwa ng’alinnya olusozi ng’asitudde omulenzi munne omulema ku mugongo gwe. Omuyise n’agamba nti, “Ng’ositudde omugugu omuzito!” Omulenzi n’addamu nti, “Ogwo si mugugu! Oyo muganda wange!” Yesu ayagala tusitule omugugu - omugugu gwe ogutazitowa. Omugugu gw’ositula gujja kuzitowa lwokka nga si gwe yakuteekerateekera (era naawe gwe wategekerwa!) Nnabbi yalabika ng’atafaayo ku mbeera ye bwe yamubuuza ky’alina mu mikono gye. “Otufuta otutono ennyo mu kacupa kwokka!” Teyategeera nti akacupa ako akatono kaalimu byonna ebyali byetaagisa okumalawo obwetaavu bwe obunene. Kiki ekiri mu ngalo zo - EKIRABO kyo? “Ekyo kiki ekiri mu ngalo zo, Musa?” Katonda bwe yabuuza. “Muggo gwa musumba gwokka,” omuweereza we bwe yaddamu. “Ekyo kimala,” Katonda bwe yagamba, “kubanga njagala oggyeyo ekisibo ky’endiga zange mu buddu bwazo mu Misiri” Katonda bulijjo ateeka mu mikono gyaffe obusobozi n’ebirabo bye twetaaga okusitula omugugu gwe. Nnabbi n’alyoka awa nnamwandu omulimu ogw’okukola - obuweereza eri baliraanwa be bonna. Kyalabika ng’ekintu eky’obusirusiru. Lwaki okuyingiza ensuwa n’ensaka nnyingi bwe zityo, ne bipipa, ne bensani? Kye yalina kyokka kaali kacupa k’amafuta akatono, - naye yakola kye yasabibwa okukola. Buli omu ku ffe yeetaaga OBUWEEREZA. “Yesu bwe yamanya nti Kitaawe yateeka byonna mu mikono gye, era nga yava wa Katonda ate gy’adda, n’asituka ku mmere, .... n’atandika okunaaza abayigirizwa be ebigere.” Yesu yagamba nti teyajja kuweerezebwa wabula okuweereza - era asuubira kye kimu okuva mu bayigirizwa be. Nnamwandu bwe yali attulula amafuta, ekintu eky’ekitalo ne kibaawo! Oyinza okuteebereza endabika y’amaaso gaabwe ng’ensuwa n’ensaka zijjuzibwa ne zibooga okuva mu kacupa k’amafuta akatono? Katonda yali awadde obuwulize bwe omukisa n’AMAFUTA ge! “Mukama, ffe tulinawo emigaati etaano gyokka n’ebyennyanja bibiri!” “Mubigabule ekibiina,” Omuyigiriza bwe yagamba. Bonna ne balya ne bakkuta - obutundutundu obwafikkawo ne babukuŋŋaanya wamu ne bujjuza ebisero kkumi na bibiri! Nnamwandu ne batabani be bombi baatunda amafuta gonna eri baliraanwa baabwe. Waaliwo ssente ezimala okusasula amabanja gonna, era n’ebyafikkawo ne bibaliisa bulungi obulamu bwabwe bwonna. Baaweebwa omukisa, baliraanwa baabwe baaweebwa omukisa, era Katonda n’aweebwa ekitiibwa. Baali bayize okubeera mu KIGENDERERWA kyabwe ekituufu - eddembe n’emikisa gya Katonda - nga babuuka ng’empungu. Omutume Pawulo yawandiikira abakkiriza ab’e Firipi nti: “Nkakasiza ddala nti oyo eyatandika omulimu omulungi mu mmwe, aligutuukiriza okutuusa ku lunaku lwa Kristo Yesu.” Kale tulambika EMITENDERA OMUKAAGA: OKWOLESEBWA OMUGUGU EKIRABO OBUWEEREZA AMAFUTA OKUBUUKA! Tujja kubyetegereza mu bujjuvu mu ssuula ezijja.

fields.title: Okwolesebwa
fields.body_html:
Bwe tuba ab’okutuuka ku kigendererwa ky’obulamu bwaffe mu Kristo, kyetaagisa nnyo okuba n’okwolesebwa okulaba okusukka embeera zaffe. Engeri gye tulabamu ebintu ejja kukwata ku ngeri gye tubeeramu, oba kwe kulaba kwaffe ku ffe ffennyini (okutunula munda), oba engeri gye tulabamu ensi (okutunula ebweru), oba engeri gye tulabamu Mukama (okutunula waggulu).

Okutunula Munda

Kigambibwa nti ‘ky’olowooza nti kye oli, kye oli.’ Kino tekituufu, kya lwatu, eri abo obulwadde bwe bubuzizza.

Oba wali owuliddeko olugero lw’abalwadde babiri abaali mu ddwaliro ly’abalalu.

“Ki kati” omu bwe yagamba, “Ggwe ani?”

“Nze Napoleon” munne bwe yaddamu.

“Nedda, si ggwe.”

“Yee nze.”

“Nedda si ggwe!”

“Yee, nze!”

“Ani eyakugambye ekyo?”

“Katonda!”

“Nedda, sikugambanga!!!”

Eky’ennaku, mu kkanisa ya Kristo mulimu bangi abazibe amaaso ku kye bali, nga balinga abalwadde abo abaali mu mbeera embi. Naye si birowoozo eby’okwegulumiza oba amalala byokka bye tulina okulwanyisa, wabula n’enneewulira ez’okwenyooma ezikontana nabyo. Ekigambo ekyo waggulu kituufu ddala mu kitundu kino ekibi. Bwe tulowooza ebirowoozo eby’okwenyooma, tubeera mu kiwonvu kye kimu n’ebirowoozo ebyo eby’okwewansa. Tusonga ku musajja eyeetwala ng’omukulu ne tumuyita “ow’amalala”, oyo Katonda gw’alissa ddala wansi.

Naye ate twanguwa okwewolereza nga tuvunaanibwa nti twenyooma ennyo, ne twongerako (n’akamalala akatono?) nti twayitibwa okuba “abawombeefu”. Kino kyonna kiraga butamanya bwa kye kitegeeza okuba omuwombeefu. Obuwombeefu si kye kikontana n’amalala - ekyo bwe buwombeefu obw’obulimba - era ekyo bulwadde obubi nga bwe gali amalala ge bukontana nago.

Twayitibwa okuba ‘abeetoowaza ng’abaana abato’ bwe tuba twagala okuba abakulu mu Bwakabaka obw’omu Ggulu. Abaana bayinza okuzannya emizannyo ne bambala engoye ez’emizannyo n’ebyenyi eby’okuzannyisa, naye ekiseera eky’okwebaka bwe kituuka, beeyambulamu eby’okuzannyisa ne bawalampa wansi w’ebibikka, nga baddamu okuba abanafu abakooye abeetaaga okugumbatirwa kitaabwe, ne maama abasiibe bulungi. Baddamu okuba ‘bo bennyini bwe bali’.

Abakulu bokka be basigala nga bambadde engoye ezo n’ebyenyi eby’okuzannyisa, kubanga tetwagala abalala batulabe nga bwe tumanyi nti bwe tuli. Bayibuli ekyo ekiyita obunnanfuusi (mu Luyonaani = okuzannya ng’omuntu omulala ).

Lowooza ku kino; ekigambo ekisinga obuwombeefu mu Bayibuli kyava eri Katonda yennyini! Musa bwe yamubuuza nti, “Bwe ndituuka mu baana ba Isirayiri, ndibagamba nti ani antumye?” Ataggwaawo n’addamu nti, “Ndi nga bwe Ndi! Bategeeze nti Ndi y’akutumye!”

Obuwombeefu kwe kumanya - n’okubeera - gwe oli ddala. Tekusukkawo, era tekukendeerawo.

Kale, ggwe ani?

Bwe tuba tutwala nti oli mukkiriza Omukristaayo, eyazaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri mu Mwoyo wa Katonda, Bayibuli erina ebintu bingi eby’ekitalo by’ekwogerako. Soma Endagaano Empya ng’onoonya ebintu ebingi eby’ekitiibwa ebigambibwa okuba obugagga obwa bonna abakkiriza. Bingi ku bugagga buno bwesigamye ku kikolwa kyaffe ekimu, naye ebisinga tebirina kya kukolagana n’obusobozi bwaffe oba obukulu bwaffe mu mwoyo, wabula byonna bikwata ku ekyo Yesu kye yatuwangulira ku musaalaba, Kitaffe ky’asanyukira okutuwa olw’okuba ayagala Omwana.

Nzikiriza nti buli mukkiriza omuggya asaanidde okuyigirizibwa essuula esooka ey’ekitabo ky’Abaefeso mu ntandikwa y’obulamu bwe obuggya, alyoke amanye ekifo kye “mu Kristo”.

Twalondebwa mu Ye, twafuulibwa abaana mu maka ga Katonda, era twakkirizibwa kubanga Kitaffe amwagala. ‘Tutuuziddwa mu bifo eby’omu ggulu’ mu Ye, waggulu ddala w’abafuzi bonna n’ab’obuyinza (ab’ekibi). Lekeraawo okukkiriza obulimba bwa Setaani ku ggwe, otandike okukkiriza Katonda ky’akwogerako!

Nnali mwonoonyi, naye Bayibuli engamba nti kaakano ndi mutukuvu!

Nnali muddu wa kibi, naye kaakano ndi mwana wa Katonda!

Ebibi byange bisonyiyiddwa, era nsobola okumuyita “Kitange!” Edda nnatambuliranga mu kizikiza naye kaakano ntambulira mu musana!

Nnali nfudde naye kaakano ndi mulamu!

Nnali nzaaye naye kaakano nzaawuse - ndi wa mu maka!

Ndi kitonde kiggya (mu mwoyo), eby’edda bigenze, era byonna bifuuse biggya.

-- si lwa kintu kyonna ekiri mu nze, wabula kubanga ndi mu Ye .

Kyasanguze waggulu ku nnyumba! Muyimuse emitwe gyammwe muyimbe! Tuli baana ba KABAKA, Aleruya! Obulamu buno bulinga akasomero k’abaserikale ak’ekiseera ekitono akatutegeka okufuga wamu ne kabaka waffe, era tusobola okuwangula kubanga abeera mu ffe, Kristo mu ffe, obukakafu bwaffe obw’ekitiibwa.

Setaani ajja kukuvunaana, ng’akuleetera okwewulira ng’omusobya n’okusalirwa omusango, naye amazima galangirira nti “tewali kiriyinza kukwawukanya n’okwagala kwa Katonda okuli mu Kristo Yesu”. Ani gw’onookkiriza - Setaani, kitaawe w’abalimba, oba Omwoyo Omutukuvu, eyawandiisa Ekigambo kya Katonda?

Embeera ziyinza okukuzitoowerera, naye osobola “okuwangula n’okukirawo mu Kristo akuwa amaanyi.” Kino okikkiriza, oba osinga kwagala kukkiriza mulabe wo, Setaani?

Ekimu ku bintu ebisinga okunakuwaza mu kkanisa ya Kristo gwe muwendo gw’abakkiriza abatamanyi kye bali (mu Kristo), era abamala ebiseera bingi nga bagezaako okweraga nti batuufu eri Katonda n’eri abalala. Kino kinakuwaza nnyo bwe kirabika mu bakulembeze abatali banywevu mu bifo byabwe (emirundi mingi kubanga Katonda si y’abayise okubeera awo), era abeetaaga okuzannya eby’obufuzi eby’omu kkanisa okusobola okukuuma ekitiibwa kyabwe. Eri abantu ng’abo kizibu nnyo okuba omuweereza Mukama waffe gwe yayita ffenna okubeera. Mu kifo ky’ekyo, banywerera ku ‘buyinza’ bwabwe, era nga bwe bakola ekyo balumya bakkiriza abalala. Waliwo olunyiriri lwa Bayibuli olubadde lunkwata nnyo ng’olw’omugaso, naye buli lwe nnulujuliza ne mbuuza abampuliriza we lusangibwa mu Byawandiikibwa, tewabangawo n’omu ansobodde kuddamu. Lugamba bwe luti.

“Yesu bwe yamanya nti Kitaawe yateeka byonna mu mikono gye, era nga yava wa Katonda ate gy’adda ....”

(Mu ngeri endala, “Yesu ng’amanyi gwe yali, gye yava, kye yali akola ne gy’agenda ....”)

Omanyi ekiddirira? (Tokyawa omuntu bw’akukwata mu kkoona bw’atyo??) Kinoonye wekka mu Njiri ya Yokaana, essuula 13! Yali munywevu mu Ye yennyini ne mu kuyitibwa kwe.

Naffe twetaaga okuba abanywevu bwe tutyo bwe tuba twagala okuba byonna Mukama by’ayagala tubeere - nga tubuuka ng’empungu. Kyangu okuweereza abalala bw’oba omanyi gwe oli ne w’oli ggwe kennyini.

Okutunula Ebweru

Olaba ki bw’otunuulira abantu mu nsi - engeri gy’olabamu ensi eri etya? Byonna ebikwetoolodde bwe birabika ng’ebitabusetabuse, lwaki wewuunya? Oteekwa okutegeera nti eno y’engeri y’ensi. Kitonde kikadde ekikooye, ekisinda era ekirumwa ng’omukazi alumwa okuzaala, nga kikulemberwa abazibe b’amaaso, nga kirindirira olunaku eyakitonda lw’alikomawo, ng’aleese naye Abaana ba Katonda.

Mu kiseera kino, ensi ejja kugoberera eddiini ey’okugulumiza omuntu (secular humanism), omuntu mw’abeera makkati g’ensi ye yennyini nga Katonda agobeddwa n’ateekebwa ku nkomerero yaayo. Ddala, mu bantu abamaze okuva ku Bukristaayo be tubeeramu kaakano, bangi bandyegasse ku bayigiriza b’eby’eddiini ab’ebirowoozo ebiggule ab’entandikwa y’ekyasa eky’amakumi abiri, nga bagamba nti Katonda yafa! Awatali mateeka amanywevu ag’okuvunaanyizibwa eri omuntu omulala atali ye yennyini, omuntu afuuka omusazi w’ensonga ez’empisa - ekituufu n’ekikyamu - abantu ne batagala nga bava mu kizibu ekimu nga bagenda mu kirala.

Nnali mu Scotland nga nkulembera olukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba wamu ne Ian ne Peter, abasumba babiri ab’ekkanisa ya Church of Scotland. Omwoyo gwa Ian gwali gunakuwavu nnyo akawungeezi ako, kwe kumubuuza ensonga. Olunaku olwo, olukiiko olukulu olw’ekkanisa y’eggwanga lwali lusazeewo okutuuza mu buweereza abasajja abeegatta ne basajja bannaabwe, ekintu Ian ne Peter bombi kye baali bakkiriza nti kikontana n’Ebyawandiikibwa. Bo, wamu n’abalala bangi, baakkirizibwa okuwandiika okuwakanya kwabwe mu biwandiiko ebitongole, naye ekiteeso kyali kiyise.

Ne ndyoka mbuuza Peter lwaki naye omwoyo gwe tegwali gunakuwavu bw’atyo. Eky’okuddamu kye kyali kizibula amaaso. Lwali lugero lw’ekikopo ekijjudde kitundu - oba ekikendeddeko kitundu - eky’amazzi. “Bwe nnatuuka mu kibuga kino emyaka abiri egiyise,” bwe yagamba, “wandisanze oboolyawo ekkanisa zaffe bbiri oba ssatu Enjiri mwe yabuulirwanga n’obwesigwa. Leero ziri abiri mu bbiri!” “Waliwo okwawukana okugenda mu maaso. Awali ekizikiza ekisinga, wabaawo n’omusana ogusinga.” Teyaganya kwolesebwa kwe ku nsi kumunyaga kwolesebwa kwe ku Mukama.

Mu kiseera kino, ggwe nange tuli mu nsi eno, naye tetuli ba nsi. Tosuubira nti ensi ejja kukusembeza. Nga bwe teyasembeza Mukama waffe Yesu, nayo bw’etyo teyinza kukukkiriza. Naye Mukama talondeddewo kutuggya mu nsi eno, kubanga ayagala tubeere bajulirwa be mu nsi. Amanyi nti ekyo kijja kuba kizibu kubanga tulina omulabe atawummula, naye yatusabira, era n’okutuusa kati akyatusabira. “Kitange, sikusaba kubaggya mu nsi, naye nkusaba obakuume eri omubi, kubanga si ba nsi nga nange bwe siri wa nsi” Kya lwatu, abakkiriza basaanidde okwenyigira mu bintu bingi eby’ensi - ng’omunnyo oguwoomya obukaawu bwayo era oguziyiza obubi bwayo; ng’omusana ogubikkula obulwadde bwayo ne gulaga ekkubo erigenda mu bulamu. Waliwo abamu abalibuuka ng’empungu mu buweereza Katonda bwe yabawa munda mu bitongole ne mu bibiina eby’ensi.

Naye ekitusinga okufaako si nsi eno, wabula Obwakabaka bwe mu mawanga g’ensi eno.

Tetwayitibwa kuyimirira mu nsi nga tujulira Kristo; twayitibwa kuyimirira mu Kristo nga tujulira eri ensi!

Yesu yayogera ku bika by’abantu bitaano b’atwala ng’abakulu mu bwakabaka bwe. Be baweereza , abali ng’abaana abato , abeetegefu okuba abasembayo oba abasinga obutono , n’abali ng’abato . Wali olowoozezza ku kye kitegeeza okuba ‘ng’omuto’? Mu biseera bya Yesu ebintu byonna ebya kitaawe w’amaka byasigirwanga mutabani we omukulu. Ennimiro n’ente zonna byali bibye. Omwana omuto yali asobola okwetikka obusika bwe bwonna ku kibegabega kye, ng’omwana omujaajaamya bwe yakola bwe yava ewaabwe. Bwe yeenenya n’akomawo ewa kitaawe, yeeraba nga tasaanira kuyitibwa mwana wa kitaawe, naye omukadde yamwaniriza n’okumugwa mu kifuba okw’okwagala, n’engatto empya, n’ekkanzu, n’embaga.

Olwo mutabani we omukulu n’asunguwala. “Lwaki otiridde omudiba ono ennyana ensava?” bw’atyo bwe yabuuza n’obusungu. Kitaawe n’amuddamu ng’amulaga nti ennyana ensava zonna zaali z’omwana omukulu. Mu butuufu, ennimiro yonna yali yiye. Byonna byali bibye! Naye mu mazima, ennimiro ye yali emufuga! Teyali afaayo ku kwenenya na kusonyiwa; kye yali afaako kyokka bye yali alina. Eno nnimiro yange! Togikwatako!

(Owulira ebigambo ebyo nga biddiŋŋana? Buno buweereza bwange/ kkanisa yange/ pulogulaamu yange/ kwaya yange! Zino ndiga zange! Tosiikuula bintu!) Kkanisa ya ani, ddala?

Okuba ‘ng’omuto’ kitegeeza nti tetukkiriza nsi eno kutufuga, wadde ebifo byayo, wadde ebintu byayo, wadde okwettanirwa kwayo, wadde ettutumu lyayo, wadde ebigendererwa byayo. ‘Tetuli ba nsi eno,’ ‘tetwesibye ku yo,’ kubanga tuli babaka b’ensi endala, ey’engulu. Kino tekitegeeza nti tetusaanidde kuba na bintu byaffe oba okukkiriza ebitiibwa bwe bituweebwa. Mu butuufu, Omukristaayo asaanidde okwawukana ku kibiina ng’omuntu akola omulimu gwe obulungi era asaanira ekitiibwa, n’okusinziira ku mitindo gy’ensi.

Naye newankubadde tuyinza okuba nga ensi yaffe, teteekwa kutufuga, era tugikwata mpola nnyo, kale Mukama waffe bw’atuyita okuva, okwesiba kwaffe ku yo tekutuziyiza. Bw’atuyita okubuuka ng’empungu, tetuba ‘basibiddwa wansi’ olw’ebituwamba, obuvunaanyizibwa, ‘emiguwa’ egyalukibwa mu myaka emingi egy’okwetaba n’ensi n’empisa zaayo.

Tusaanidde okutegeera nti obulamu buno - mu nsi eno - nkambi ya kutendekebwamu yokka Katonda gye yateekateeka okututuukiriza olw’ensi entuufu ey’Emirembe n’Emirembe. Anoonya abantu abaliwangula mu bulamu buno, balyoke bafugire wamu naye mu bulamu obujja. Tekitwewuunyisa nti abasajja bayita mu kunyigirizibwa okw’amaanyi ne mu kuswazibwa bwe baba batendekebwa okufuuka aba Marines, naye emirundi mingi tutandika okwemulugunya Mukama waffe bw’akkiriza ebizibu n’empologoma ewuluguma okutulumba mu kutendekebwa kwaffe. Tuba beetegefu nnyo okwonoona okwetegeka kwaffe nga tunoonya okuba mikwano gy’ensi.

Naye bwe tuba bye Mukama yatuyita okufuuka, tuliba bawanguzi, ne mu nsi eno, era Obwakabaka bwe bulinywezebwa mu nsi, nga bwe buli mu ggulu . Alizimba Ekkanisa ye n’amaanyi gonna aga Setaani tegaligiwangula.

Ate era, kkapa ‘ekaaba’ tekwata muyiggo gwayo; n’empologoma ewuluguma nayo tesobola, okuggyako bwe tugiwa amaanyi nga tukkiriza okuwuluguma kwayo okukwata ku nneewulira zaffe ne kusannyalaza ebikolwa byaffe.

Akozesa okutya, ensonyi, obuggya, obukwafu, obusungu n’enneewulira endala embi ezifaanana ng’ezo okutunyaga obuwanguzi bwaffe. Tusaanidde okuyiga okutegeera enkola ze, ne tumalirira obutakkiriza nneewulira ezo kutuziyiza. Nnamala omwezi gumu ogw’essanyu lingi mu Nepal nga nkuba emisomo egiwerako eri abaminsani era nga ntambula okubuna ekitundu kinene eky’eggwanga eryo.

Mu kibuga Dharan, nnayanjulirwa omusajja omukadde eyali amaze emyaka mingi ng’omusumba eyo mu kiseera amakanisa we gaayigganyizibwa ennyo. Yali akwatiddwa emirundi egisukka mu abiri mu etaano, era ng’asibiddwa emirundi musanvu, ekiseera ekisinga obuwanvu nga kya myaka munaana. Amangu ddala nga yaakateebwa okuva mu kkomera, yaddangayo mu kyalo kye n’atandika okubuulira Enjiri nate. Nnamubuuza nti, “Tewatya kukwatibwa nate?” Yanziramu nti “Lwaki ntya? Empologoma emaze okuwuluguma nga bw’esobola okusinga!” Yalina okwolesebwa okutuufu - amaaso agalaba 20/20 mu by’omwoyo!

Jim Elliot, omu ku bavubuka bataano abattibwa olw’okukkiriza mu bibira bya Ecuador mu 1959, ye yawandiika nga wakyabulayo akaseera afe nti, “Si musirusiru oyo aleka ky’atasobola kukuuma okufuna ky’atasobola kufiirwa!”

Kya lwatu, ensi eno teyali emufuga kubanga yalina okwolesebwa okusinga nnyo ensi eno.

Yesu yali amanyi ebiribaawo eri omuntu ku nsi mu biseera eby’omu maaso, kyava atugamba nti “ebintu ebyo bwe bitandikanga muyimiriranga butereevu ne muyimusa amaaso gammwe waggulu! Kubanga okulokolebwa kwammwe nga kusembedde.” Okwolesebwa kwaffe kusaanidde okuba okw’okutunula waggulu.

Okutunula Waggulu

Ensi eyinza okugamba mu buzibe bwayo nti ‘Katonda yafa’ naye abatuuze b’obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu bamanyi amazima ag’enjawulo. Katonda akyali ku ntebe ye ey’obwakabaka era atuusa ebintu byonna ku ntikko yaabyo, olwo ekiseera ekituufu bwe kirituuka, ateeke ebintu byonna awamu wansi wa Kristo, ebiri mu ggulu n’ebiri ku nsi . Alituukiriza ebigendererwa bye.

Mu 2 Bassekabaka 6, tusoma ku buzibu nnabbi Erisa bwe yayitamu oluvannyuma lw’okutegeeza kabaka we enteekateeka ab’e Busuuli ze baali bakola okulumba Isirayiri. Kabaka wa Busuuli yatuma eggye ddene okukwata nnabbi mu kibuga Dosani. Enjuba bwe yali evaayo, omuweereza wa nnabbi n’azuukuka ku kitanda kye n’aggulawo amadirisa okwaniriza olunaku oluggya. Teebereza okwewuunya n’entiisa bye yafuna bwe yalaba ekibuga nga kyetooloddwa eggye ly’e Busuuli. Embeera teyali nnungi n’akatono! Byonna byalabika nga bizibye. Ensi yonna yalabika ng’esimbye ekitala eri omusajja wa Katonda.

“Ayi mukama wange tunaakola tutya?” omuweereza bwe yayogerera waggulu.

Erisa n’azuukuka ku kitanda kye, n’atambulako mpola okutuuka ku ddirisa, n’atunuulira omulabe, n’asaba. Tewaali bigambo bya kweraliikirira, tewaali kwegayirira kwa kununulibwa, tewaali bibuuzo yabuuza Katonda. Kusaba kwangu bwangu, “Ayi Mukama, zibula amaaso ge asobole okulaba!”

Mukama n’azibula amaaso ag’omuvubuka oyo, n’alaba ng’ensozi ezeetoolodde ekibuga zijjudde embalaasi n’amagaali ag’omuliro ag’eggye lya Katonda. Kabaka wa Busuuli yandituma eggye lye eddene, naye tebandisobodde musajja wa Katonda. Nga tuli ne Katonda bulijjo ‘tuwangudde n’okukirawo’ ku byonna omulabe oba ensi bye biyinza okutukasuukirira. Twetaaga okutunula waggulu tulabe nti ensozi ezeetoolodde embeera zaffe zijjudde amaggye ga Mukama, nga galindirira bulindirizi ekiragiro kye okusumululwa mu mbeera eyo.

Kabaka Dawudi yayolekera ennaku nnyingi nga byonna birabika ng’ebimulwanyisa. Kabaka Sawulo yagezaako okumutta emirundi egiwerako era n’amuyigga oluvannyuma lw’okuva mu lubiri e Yerusaalemi, ne kiba nti okumala emyaka yabeera bulamu bwa mugobe. Naye ku nnaku ezisinga okunakuwaza mu bulamu bwe kwaliko olwo lwe yategeera nti mutabani we Abusaalomu yali akuŋŋaanya eggye okuggya kitaawe ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka bwa Isirayiri. Dawudi awandiika enkyukakyuka y’enneewulira ye mu Zabbuli 3. - Okuva ku mbeera ey’okuggwaamu essuubi mu lunyiriri 1 (‘Ayi Mukama, abalabe bange nga beeyongedde obungi!’) okutuuka ku bwesige mu lunyiriri 8 (‘Obulokozi buva gy’oli, Ayi Mukama!’). Tusaanidde okwetegereza olunyiriri 3 tulabe enkyukakyuka eyo mu ndowooza bwe yajja “Naye ggwe, Ayi Mukama, ggwe ngabo yange enkuuma; ggwe kitiibwa kyange, era gw’onzizaamu amaanyi.” Oluvannyuma yaliwandiika nti “Nnyimusa amaaso gange eri ensozi, okubeerwa kwange kuva wa? Okubeerwa kwange kuva eri Mukama!”

Embeera yo ebeere etya, omulabe akuvunaane atya, ensi ekunyiize etya, yimusa amaaso go otunuulire amazima ag’omu ggulu. Awasa omugole wo alindiridde, emmeeza y’ekijjulo etegekeddwa, era mu bbanga ttono tujja kuwulira eddoboozi ly’ekkondeere nga lituyita ku kijjulo ky’embaga ey’obugole ey’Omwana gw’Endiga.

Mukama wo y’afuga byonna, era osobola okukakasiza ddala nti ‘oyo eyatandika omulimu omulungi mu mmwe, aligutuukiriza okutuusa ku lunaku lwa Kristo Yesu.’

Kino si kulowooza kwa bulungi bwa mu birowoozo bwokka, wabula kigambo kitegeevu ekiraga essuubi lyaffe (kwe kugamba; okulindirira n’obwesige ekyo ekikakafu .) Okutuusa olwo, ayagala tubuuke ng’empungu!

Oyinza okuba n’endowooza ennungi ku ggwe kennyini, endowooza entuufu ku nsi n’essuubi ery’amaanyi mu Mukama, naye endowooza yo ku Kkanisa eri etya? Nnafu era tekola kya maanyi, ng’erina kye ekoze kitono mu nsi yo? Efuuse kitongole mu kifo ky’okuba ekiramu - Omubiri gwa Kristo omulamu? Essira erisinga eriteeka ku pulogulaamu mu kifo ky’okufaayo ku bantu?

Emu ku nkizo ennene ze nnina, kwe kutambula mu mawanga mangi okuweereza abavubuka n’abakulembeze b’amakanisa. Njagala okukireekaana mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka era eritegeerekeka nti Ekkanisa ya Yesu Kristo nnamu era eri bulungi, mu bifo bingi. Buli we ŋŋenda nsisinkana abasajja n’abakazi abakola ebintu ebikulu eri Katonda, wadde nga, kya lwatu, amawulire ag’ensi tegatubuulira bingi ku bakkiriza bano abakyusa ensi yaabwe. Kye baba balina bonna gwe mugugu, n’okwolesebwa okunene okwa Katonda by’asobola okukola ng’abayitamu.

Loren Cunningham ng’akyali muvubuka, yafuna okwolesebwa. Kwali kwa mayengo g’abavubuka nga basumululwa ne batuuka ng’amayengo g’ennyanja ku mbalama z’ensi. Yakkiriza nti Katonda yali asobola okukubiriza ebibiina by’abantu okufuluma n’emikono ebiri egy’Enjiri. Baali ba kwogera amawulire amalungi era ne balaga engeri ya Yesu mu bikolwa byabwe.

Leero, Youth With A Mission emanyiddwa mu nsi yonna, ng’erina ekibinja ky’abaminsani eky’abakozi ng’enkumi munaana abaweereza mu mawanga agasukka mu ataano, era ng’eweerezza mu buli ggwanga erikkirizibwa United Nations.

Kale okwolesebwa kwo kwe kuruwa?
fields.body_text: Bwe tuba ab’okutuuka ku kigendererwa ky’obulamu bwaffe mu Kristo, kyetaagisa nnyo okuba n’okwolesebwa okulaba okusukka embeera zaffe. Engeri gye tulabamu ebintu ejja kukwata ku ngeri gye tubeeramu, oba kwe kulaba kwaffe ku ffe ffennyini (okutunula munda), oba engeri gye tulabamu ensi (okutunula ebweru), oba engeri gye tulabamu Mukama (okutunula waggulu). Okutunula Munda Kigambibwa nti ‘ky’olowooza nti kye oli, kye oli.’ Kino tekituufu, kya lwatu, eri abo obulwadde bwe bubuzizza. Oba wali owuliddeko olugero lw’abalwadde babiri abaali mu ddwaliro ly’abalalu. “Ki kati” omu bwe yagamba, “Ggwe ani?” “Nze Napoleon” munne bwe yaddamu. “Nedda, si ggwe.” “Yee nze.” “Nedda si ggwe!” “Yee, nze!” “Ani eyakugambye ekyo?” “Katonda!” “Nedda, sikugambanga!!!” Eky’ennaku, mu kkanisa ya Kristo mulimu bangi abazibe amaaso ku kye bali, nga balinga abalwadde abo abaali mu mbeera embi. Naye si birowoozo eby’okwegulumiza oba amalala byokka bye tulina okulwanyisa, wabula n’enneewulira ez’okwenyooma ezikontana nabyo. Ekigambo ekyo waggulu kituufu ddala mu kitundu kino ekibi. Bwe tulowooza ebirowoozo eby’okwenyooma, tubeera mu kiwonvu kye kimu n’ebirowoozo ebyo eby’okwewansa. Tusonga ku musajja eyeetwala ng’omukulu ne tumuyita “ow’amalala”, oyo Katonda gw’alissa ddala wansi. Naye ate twanguwa okwewolereza nga tuvunaanibwa nti twenyooma ennyo, ne twongerako (n’akamalala akatono?) nti twayitibwa okuba “abawombeefu”. Kino kyonna kiraga butamanya bwa kye kitegeeza okuba omuwombeefu. Obuwombeefu si kye kikontana n’amalala - ekyo bwe buwombeefu obw’obulimba - era ekyo bulwadde obubi nga bwe gali amalala ge bukontana nago. Twayitibwa okuba ‘abeetoowaza ng’abaana abato’ bwe tuba twagala okuba abakulu mu Bwakabaka obw’omu Ggulu. Abaana bayinza okuzannya emizannyo ne bambala engoye ez’emizannyo n’ebyenyi eby’okuzannyisa, naye ekiseera eky’okwebaka bwe kituuka, beeyambulamu eby’okuzannyisa ne bawalampa wansi w’ebibikka, nga baddamu okuba abanafu abakooye abeetaaga okugumbatirwa kitaabwe, ne maama abasiibe bulungi. Baddamu okuba ‘bo bennyini bwe bali’. Abakulu bokka be basigala nga bambadde engoye ezo n’ebyenyi eby’okuzannyisa, kubanga tetwagala abalala batulabe nga bwe tumanyi nti bwe tuli. Bayibuli ekyo ekiyita obunnanfuusi (mu Luyonaani = okuzannya ng’omuntu omulala ). Lowooza ku kino; ekigambo ekisinga obuwombeefu mu Bayibuli kyava eri Katonda yennyini! Musa bwe yamubuuza nti, “Bwe ndituuka mu baana ba Isirayiri, ndibagamba nti ani antumye?” Ataggwaawo n’addamu nti, “Ndi nga bwe Ndi! Bategeeze nti Ndi y’akutumye!” Obuwombeefu kwe kumanya - n’okubeera - gwe oli ddala. Tekusukkawo, era tekukendeerawo. Kale, ggwe ani? Bwe tuba tutwala nti oli mukkiriza Omukristaayo, eyazaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri mu Mwoyo wa Katonda, Bayibuli erina ebintu bingi eby’ekitalo by’ekwogerako. Soma Endagaano Empya ng’onoonya ebintu ebingi eby’ekitiibwa ebigambibwa okuba obugagga obwa bonna abakkiriza. Bingi ku bugagga buno bwesigamye ku kikolwa kyaffe ekimu, naye ebisinga tebirina kya kukolagana n’obusobozi bwaffe oba obukulu bwaffe mu mwoyo, wabula byonna bikwata ku ekyo Yesu kye yatuwangulira ku musaalaba, Kitaffe ky’asanyukira okutuwa olw’okuba ayagala Omwana. Nzikiriza nti buli mukkiriza omuggya asaanidde okuyigirizibwa essuula esooka ey’ekitabo ky’Abaefeso mu ntandikwa y’obulamu bwe obuggya, alyoke amanye ekifo kye “mu Kristo”. Twalondebwa mu Ye, twafuulibwa abaana mu maka ga Katonda, era twakkirizibwa kubanga Kitaffe amwagala. ‘Tutuuziddwa mu bifo eby’omu ggulu’ mu Ye, waggulu ddala w’abafuzi bonna n’ab’obuyinza (ab’ekibi). Lekeraawo okukkiriza obulimba bwa Setaani ku ggwe, otandike okukkiriza Katonda ky’akwogerako! Nnali mwonoonyi, naye Bayibuli engamba nti kaakano ndi mutukuvu! Nnali muddu wa kibi, naye kaakano ndi mwana wa Katonda! Ebibi byange bisonyiyiddwa, era nsobola okumuyita “Kitange!” Edda nnatambuliranga mu kizikiza naye kaakano ntambulira mu musana! Nnali nfudde naye kaakano ndi mulamu! Nnali nzaaye naye kaakano nzaawuse - ndi wa mu maka! Ndi kitonde kiggya (mu mwoyo), eby’edda bigenze, era byonna bifuuse biggya. -- si lwa kintu kyonna ekiri mu nze, wabula kubanga ndi mu Ye . Kyasanguze waggulu ku nnyumba! Muyimuse emitwe gyammwe muyimbe! Tuli baana ba KABAKA, Aleruya! Obulamu buno bulinga akasomero k’abaserikale ak’ekiseera ekitono akatutegeka okufuga wamu ne kabaka waffe, era tusobola okuwangula kubanga abeera mu ffe, Kristo mu ffe, obukakafu bwaffe obw’ekitiibwa. Setaani ajja kukuvunaana, ng’akuleetera okwewulira ng’omusobya n’okusalirwa omusango, naye amazima galangirira nti “tewali kiriyinza kukwawukanya n’okwagala kwa Katonda okuli mu Kristo Yesu”. Ani gw’onookkiriza - Setaani, kitaawe w’abalimba, oba Omwoyo Omutukuvu, eyawandiisa Ekigambo kya Katonda? Embeera ziyinza okukuzitoowerera, naye osobola “okuwangula n’okukirawo mu Kristo akuwa amaanyi.” Kino okikkiriza, oba osinga kwagala kukkiriza mulabe wo, Setaani? Ekimu ku bintu ebisinga okunakuwaza mu kkanisa ya Kristo gwe muwendo gw’abakkiriza abatamanyi kye bali (mu Kristo), era abamala ebiseera bingi nga bagezaako okweraga nti batuufu eri Katonda n’eri abalala. Kino kinakuwaza nnyo bwe kirabika mu bakulembeze abatali banywevu mu bifo byabwe (emirundi mingi kubanga Katonda si y’abayise okubeera awo), era abeetaaga okuzannya eby’obufuzi eby’omu kkanisa okusobola okukuuma ekitiibwa kyabwe. Eri abantu ng’abo kizibu nnyo okuba omuweereza Mukama waffe gwe yayita ffenna okubeera. Mu kifo ky’ekyo, banywerera ku ‘buyinza’ bwabwe, era nga bwe bakola ekyo balumya bakkiriza abalala. Waliwo olunyiriri lwa Bayibuli olubadde lunkwata nnyo ng’olw’omugaso, naye buli lwe nnulujuliza ne mbuuza abampuliriza we lusangibwa mu Byawandiikibwa, tewabangawo n’omu ansobodde kuddamu. Lugamba bwe luti. “Yesu bwe yamanya nti Kitaawe yateeka byonna mu mikono gye, era nga yava wa Katonda ate gy’adda ....” (Mu ngeri endala, “Yesu ng’amanyi gwe yali, gye yava, kye yali akola ne gy’agenda ....”) Omanyi ekiddirira? (Tokyawa omuntu bw’akukwata mu kkoona bw’atyo??) Kinoonye wekka mu Njiri ya Yokaana, essuula 13! Yali munywevu mu Ye yennyini ne mu kuyitibwa kwe. Naffe twetaaga okuba abanywevu bwe tutyo bwe tuba twagala okuba byonna Mukama by’ayagala tubeere - nga tubuuka ng’empungu. Kyangu okuweereza abalala bw’oba omanyi gwe oli ne w’oli ggwe kennyini. Okutunula Ebweru Olaba ki bw’otunuulira abantu mu nsi - engeri gy’olabamu ensi eri etya? Byonna ebikwetoolodde bwe birabika ng’ebitabusetabuse, lwaki wewuunya? Oteekwa okutegeera nti eno y’engeri y’ensi. Kitonde kikadde ekikooye, ekisinda era ekirumwa ng’omukazi alumwa okuzaala, nga kikulemberwa abazibe b’amaaso, nga kirindirira olunaku eyakitonda lw’alikomawo, ng’aleese naye Abaana ba Katonda. Mu kiseera kino, ensi ejja kugoberera eddiini ey’okugulumiza omuntu (secular humanism), omuntu mw’abeera makkati g’ensi ye yennyini nga Katonda agobeddwa n’ateekebwa ku nkomerero yaayo. Ddala, mu bantu abamaze okuva ku Bukristaayo be tubeeramu kaakano, bangi bandyegasse ku bayigiriza b’eby’eddiini ab’ebirowoozo ebiggule ab’entandikwa y’ekyasa eky’amakumi abiri, nga bagamba nti Katonda yafa! Awatali mateeka amanywevu ag’okuvunaanyizibwa eri omuntu omulala atali ye yennyini, omuntu afuuka omusazi w’ensonga ez’empisa - ekituufu n’ekikyamu - abantu ne batagala nga bava mu kizibu ekimu nga bagenda mu kirala. Nnali mu Scotland nga nkulembera olukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba wamu ne Ian ne Peter, abasumba babiri ab’ekkanisa ya Church of Scotland. Omwoyo gwa Ian gwali gunakuwavu nnyo akawungeezi ako, kwe kumubuuza ensonga. Olunaku olwo, olukiiko olukulu olw’ekkanisa y’eggwanga lwali lusazeewo okutuuza mu buweereza abasajja abeegatta ne basajja bannaabwe, ekintu Ian ne Peter bombi kye baali bakkiriza nti kikontana n’Ebyawandiikibwa. Bo, wamu n’abalala bangi, baakkirizibwa okuwandiika okuwakanya kwabwe mu biwandiiko ebitongole, naye ekiteeso kyali kiyise. Ne ndyoka mbuuza Peter lwaki naye omwoyo gwe tegwali gunakuwavu bw’atyo. Eky’okuddamu kye kyali kizibula amaaso. Lwali lugero lw’ekikopo ekijjudde kitundu - oba ekikendeddeko kitundu - eky’amazzi. “Bwe nnatuuka mu kibuga kino emyaka abiri egiyise,” bwe yagamba, “wandisanze oboolyawo ekkanisa zaffe bbiri oba ssatu Enjiri mwe yabuulirwanga n’obwesigwa. Leero ziri abiri mu bbiri!” “Waliwo okwawukana okugenda mu maaso. Awali ekizikiza ekisinga, wabaawo n’omusana ogusinga.” Teyaganya kwolesebwa kwe ku nsi kumunyaga kwolesebwa kwe ku Mukama. Mu kiseera kino, ggwe nange tuli mu nsi eno, naye tetuli ba nsi. Tosuubira nti ensi ejja kukusembeza. Nga bwe teyasembeza Mukama waffe Yesu, nayo bw’etyo teyinza kukukkiriza. Naye Mukama talondeddewo kutuggya mu nsi eno, kubanga ayagala tubeere bajulirwa be mu nsi. Amanyi nti ekyo kijja kuba kizibu kubanga tulina omulabe atawummula, naye yatusabira, era n’okutuusa kati akyatusabira. “Kitange, sikusaba kubaggya mu nsi, naye nkusaba obakuume eri omubi, kubanga si ba nsi nga nange bwe siri wa nsi” Kya lwatu, abakkiriza basaanidde okwenyigira mu bintu bingi eby’ensi - ng’omunnyo oguwoomya obukaawu bwayo era oguziyiza obubi bwayo; ng’omusana ogubikkula obulwadde bwayo ne gulaga ekkubo erigenda mu bulamu. Waliwo abamu abalibuuka ng’empungu mu buweereza Katonda bwe yabawa munda mu bitongole ne mu bibiina eby’ensi. Naye ekitusinga okufaako si nsi eno, wabula Obwakabaka bwe mu mawanga g’ensi eno. Tetwayitibwa kuyimirira mu nsi nga tujulira Kristo; twayitibwa kuyimirira mu Kristo nga tujulira eri ensi! Yesu yayogera ku bika by’abantu bitaano b’atwala ng’abakulu mu bwakabaka bwe. Be baweereza , abali ng’abaana abato , abeetegefu okuba abasembayo oba abasinga obutono , n’abali ng’abato . Wali olowoozezza ku kye kitegeeza okuba ‘ng’omuto’? Mu biseera bya Yesu ebintu byonna ebya kitaawe w’amaka byasigirwanga mutabani we omukulu. Ennimiro n’ente zonna byali bibye. Omwana omuto yali asobola okwetikka obusika bwe bwonna ku kibegabega kye, ng’omwana omujaajaamya bwe yakola bwe yava ewaabwe. Bwe yeenenya n’akomawo ewa kitaawe, yeeraba nga tasaanira kuyitibwa mwana wa kitaawe, naye omukadde yamwaniriza n’okumugwa mu kifuba okw’okwagala, n’engatto empya, n’ekkanzu, n’embaga. Olwo mutabani we omukulu n’asunguwala. “Lwaki otiridde omudiba ono ennyana ensava?” bw’atyo bwe yabuuza n’obusungu. Kitaawe n’amuddamu ng’amulaga nti ennyana ensava zonna zaali z’omwana omukulu. Mu butuufu, ennimiro yonna yali yiye. Byonna byali bibye! Naye mu mazima, ennimiro ye yali emufuga! Teyali afaayo ku kwenenya na kusonyiwa; kye yali afaako kyokka bye yali alina. Eno nnimiro yange! Togikwatako! (Owulira ebigambo ebyo nga biddiŋŋana? Buno buweereza bwange/ kkanisa yange/ pulogulaamu yange/ kwaya yange! Zino ndiga zange! Tosiikuula bintu!) Kkanisa ya ani, ddala? Okuba ‘ng’omuto’ kitegeeza nti tetukkiriza nsi eno kutufuga, wadde ebifo byayo, wadde ebintu byayo, wadde okwettanirwa kwayo, wadde ettutumu lyayo, wadde ebigendererwa byayo. ‘Tetuli ba nsi eno,’ ‘tetwesibye ku yo,’ kubanga tuli babaka b’ensi endala, ey’engulu. Kino tekitegeeza nti tetusaanidde kuba na bintu byaffe oba okukkiriza ebitiibwa bwe bituweebwa. Mu butuufu, Omukristaayo asaanidde okwawukana ku kibiina ng’omuntu akola omulimu gwe obulungi era asaanira ekitiibwa, n’okusinziira ku mitindo gy’ensi. Naye newankubadde tuyinza okuba nga ensi yaffe, teteekwa kutufuga, era tugikwata mpola nnyo, kale Mukama waffe bw’atuyita okuva, okwesiba kwaffe ku yo tekutuziyiza. Bw’atuyita okubuuka ng’empungu, tetuba ‘basibiddwa wansi’ olw’ebituwamba, obuvunaanyizibwa, ‘emiguwa’ egyalukibwa mu myaka emingi egy’okwetaba n’ensi n’empisa zaayo. Tusaanidde okutegeera nti obulamu buno - mu nsi eno - nkambi ya kutendekebwamu yokka Katonda gye yateekateeka okututuukiriza olw’ensi entuufu ey’Emirembe n’Emirembe. Anoonya abantu abaliwangula mu bulamu buno, balyoke bafugire wamu naye mu bulamu obujja. Tekitwewuunyisa nti abasajja bayita mu kunyigirizibwa okw’amaanyi ne mu kuswazibwa bwe baba batendekebwa okufuuka aba Marines, naye emirundi mingi tutandika okwemulugunya Mukama waffe bw’akkiriza ebizibu n’empologoma ewuluguma okutulumba mu kutendekebwa kwaffe. Tuba beetegefu nnyo okwonoona okwetegeka kwaffe nga tunoonya okuba mikwano gy’ensi. Naye bwe tuba bye Mukama yatuyita okufuuka, tuliba bawanguzi, ne mu nsi eno, era Obwakabaka bwe bulinywezebwa mu nsi, nga bwe buli mu ggulu . Alizimba Ekkanisa ye n’amaanyi gonna aga Setaani tegaligiwangula. Ate era, kkapa ‘ekaaba’ tekwata muyiggo gwayo; n’empologoma ewuluguma nayo tesobola, okuggyako bwe tugiwa amaanyi nga tukkiriza okuwuluguma kwayo okukwata ku nneewulira zaffe ne kusannyalaza ebikolwa byaffe. Akozesa okutya, ensonyi, obuggya, obukwafu, obusungu n’enneewulira endala embi ezifaanana ng’ezo okutunyaga obuwanguzi bwaffe. Tusaanidde okuyiga okutegeera enkola ze, ne tumalirira obutakkiriza nneewulira ezo kutuziyiza. Nnamala omwezi gumu ogw’essanyu lingi mu Nepal nga nkuba emisomo egiwerako eri abaminsani era nga ntambula okubuna ekitundu kinene eky’eggwanga eryo. Mu kibuga Dharan, nnayanjulirwa omusajja omukadde eyali amaze emyaka mingi ng’omusumba eyo mu kiseera amakanisa we gaayigganyizibwa ennyo. Yali akwatiddwa emirundi egisukka mu abiri mu etaano, era ng’asibiddwa emirundi musanvu, ekiseera ekisinga obuwanvu nga kya myaka munaana. Amangu ddala nga yaakateebwa okuva mu kkomera, yaddangayo mu kyalo kye n’atandika okubuulira Enjiri nate. Nnamubuuza nti, “Tewatya kukwatibwa nate?” Yanziramu nti “Lwaki ntya? Empologoma emaze okuwuluguma nga bw’esobola okusinga!” Yalina okwolesebwa okutuufu - amaaso agalaba 20/20 mu by’omwoyo! Jim Elliot, omu ku bavubuka bataano abattibwa olw’okukkiriza mu bibira bya Ecuador mu 1959, ye yawandiika nga wakyabulayo akaseera afe nti, “Si musirusiru oyo aleka ky’atasobola kukuuma okufuna ky’atasobola kufiirwa!” Kya lwatu, ensi eno teyali emufuga kubanga yalina okwolesebwa okusinga nnyo ensi eno. Yesu yali amanyi ebiribaawo eri omuntu ku nsi mu biseera eby’omu maaso, kyava atugamba nti “ebintu ebyo bwe bitandikanga muyimiriranga butereevu ne muyimusa amaaso gammwe waggulu! Kubanga okulokolebwa kwammwe nga kusembedde.” Okwolesebwa kwaffe kusaanidde okuba okw’okutunula waggulu. Okutunula Waggulu Ensi eyinza okugamba mu buzibe bwayo nti ‘Katonda yafa’ naye abatuuze b’obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu bamanyi amazima ag’enjawulo. Katonda akyali ku ntebe ye ey’obwakabaka era atuusa ebintu byonna ku ntikko yaabyo, olwo ekiseera ekituufu bwe kirituuka, ateeke ebintu byonna awamu wansi wa Kristo, ebiri mu ggulu n’ebiri ku nsi . Alituukiriza ebigendererwa bye. Mu 2 Bassekabaka 6, tusoma ku buzibu nnabbi Erisa bwe yayitamu oluvannyuma lw’okutegeeza kabaka we enteekateeka ab’e Busuuli ze baali bakola okulumba Isirayiri. Kabaka wa Busuuli yatuma eggye ddene okukwata nnabbi mu kibuga Dosani. Enjuba bwe yali evaayo, omuweereza wa nnabbi n’azuukuka ku kitanda kye n’aggulawo amadirisa okwaniriza olunaku oluggya. Teebereza okwewuunya n’entiisa bye yafuna bwe yalaba ekibuga nga kyetooloddwa eggye ly’e Busuuli. Embeera teyali nnungi n’akatono! Byonna byalabika nga bizibye. Ensi yonna yalabika ng’esimbye ekitala eri omusajja wa Katonda. “Ayi mukama wange tunaakola tutya?” omuweereza bwe yayogerera waggulu. Erisa n’azuukuka ku kitanda kye, n’atambulako mpola okutuuka ku ddirisa, n’atunuulira omulabe, n’asaba. Tewaali bigambo bya kweraliikirira, tewaali kwegayirira kwa kununulibwa, tewaali bibuuzo yabuuza Katonda. Kusaba kwangu bwangu, “Ayi Mukama, zibula amaaso ge asobole okulaba!” Mukama n’azibula amaaso ag’omuvubuka oyo, n’alaba ng’ensozi ezeetoolodde ekibuga zijjudde embalaasi n’amagaali ag’omuliro ag’eggye lya Katonda. Kabaka wa Busuuli yandituma eggye lye eddene, naye tebandisobodde musajja wa Katonda. Nga tuli ne Katonda bulijjo ‘tuwangudde n’okukirawo’ ku byonna omulabe oba ensi bye biyinza okutukasuukirira. Twetaaga okutunula waggulu tulabe nti ensozi ezeetoolodde embeera zaffe zijjudde amaggye ga Mukama, nga galindirira bulindirizi ekiragiro kye okusumululwa mu mbeera eyo. Kabaka Dawudi yayolekera ennaku nnyingi nga byonna birabika ng’ebimulwanyisa. Kabaka Sawulo yagezaako okumutta emirundi egiwerako era n’amuyigga oluvannyuma lw’okuva mu lubiri e Yerusaalemi, ne kiba nti okumala emyaka yabeera bulamu bwa mugobe. Naye ku nnaku ezisinga okunakuwaza mu bulamu bwe kwaliko olwo lwe yategeera nti mutabani we Abusaalomu yali akuŋŋaanya eggye okuggya kitaawe ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka bwa Isirayiri. Dawudi awandiika enkyukakyuka y’enneewulira ye mu Zabbuli 3. - Okuva ku mbeera ey’okuggwaamu essuubi mu lunyiriri 1 (‘Ayi Mukama, abalabe bange nga beeyongedde obungi!’) okutuuka ku bwesige mu lunyiriri 8 (‘Obulokozi buva gy’oli, Ayi Mukama!’). Tusaanidde okwetegereza olunyiriri 3 tulabe enkyukakyuka eyo mu ndowooza bwe yajja “Naye ggwe, Ayi Mukama, ggwe ngabo yange enkuuma; ggwe kitiibwa kyange, era gw’onzizaamu amaanyi.” Oluvannyuma yaliwandiika nti “Nnyimusa amaaso gange eri ensozi, okubeerwa kwange kuva wa? Okubeerwa kwange kuva eri Mukama!” Embeera yo ebeere etya, omulabe akuvunaane atya, ensi ekunyiize etya, yimusa amaaso go otunuulire amazima ag’omu ggulu. Awasa omugole wo alindiridde, emmeeza y’ekijjulo etegekeddwa, era mu bbanga ttono tujja kuwulira eddoboozi ly’ekkondeere nga lituyita ku kijjulo ky’embaga ey’obugole ey’Omwana gw’Endiga. Mukama wo y’afuga byonna, era osobola okukakasiza ddala nti ‘oyo eyatandika omulimu omulungi mu mmwe, aligutuukiriza okutuusa ku lunaku lwa Kristo Yesu.’ Kino si kulowooza kwa bulungi bwa mu birowoozo bwokka, wabula kigambo kitegeevu ekiraga essuubi lyaffe (kwe kugamba; okulindirira n’obwesige ekyo ekikakafu .) Okutuusa olwo, ayagala tubuuke ng’empungu! Oyinza okuba n’endowooza ennungi ku ggwe kennyini, endowooza entuufu ku nsi n’essuubi ery’amaanyi mu Mukama, naye endowooza yo ku Kkanisa eri etya? Nnafu era tekola kya maanyi, ng’erina kye ekoze kitono mu nsi yo? Efuuse kitongole mu kifo ky’okuba ekiramu - Omubiri gwa Kristo omulamu? Essira erisinga eriteeka ku pulogulaamu mu kifo ky’okufaayo ku bantu? Emu ku nkizo ennene ze nnina, kwe kutambula mu mawanga mangi okuweereza abavubuka n’abakulembeze b’amakanisa. Njagala okukireekaana mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka era eritegeerekeka nti Ekkanisa ya Yesu Kristo nnamu era eri bulungi, mu bifo bingi. Buli we ŋŋenda nsisinkana abasajja n’abakazi abakola ebintu ebikulu eri Katonda, wadde nga, kya lwatu, amawulire ag’ensi tegatubuulira bingi ku bakkiriza bano abakyusa ensi yaabwe. Kye baba balina bonna gwe mugugu, n’okwolesebwa okunene okwa Katonda by’asobola okukola ng’abayitamu. Loren Cunningham ng’akyali muvubuka, yafuna okwolesebwa. Kwali kwa mayengo g’abavubuka nga basumululwa ne batuuka ng’amayengo g’ennyanja ku mbalama z’ensi. Yakkiriza nti Katonda yali asobola okukubiriza ebibiina by’abantu okufuluma n’emikono ebiri egy’Enjiri. Baali ba kwogera amawulire amalungi era ne balaga engeri ya Yesu mu bikolwa byabwe. Leero, Youth With A Mission emanyiddwa mu nsi yonna, ng’erina ekibinja ky’abaminsani eky’abakozi ng’enkumi munaana abaweereza mu mawanga agasukka mu ataano, era ng’eweerezza mu buli ggwanga erikkirizibwa United Nations. Kale okwolesebwa kwo kwe kuruwa?

fields.title: Omugugu
fields.body_html:
Nkyajjukira bulungi akawungeezi we nnasabira Mukama ampe omugugu gw’abavubuka. Nnali musomesa mu ssomero ly’Eggye lya Bungereza (British Forces) mu Bugirimaani, era nnali mpulira nti obujulirwa bwange obw’akamwa eri abayizi bwali tebumala, kyennava nkaabirira mu kusaba nsabe omugugu gwe nnalowooza nti gwandimpadde amaanyi ag’okujulira ennyo. Saalaba kyanzibwa kyonna amangu ago, naye nnafuna obuvumu obusingako mu kwogera n’abamu ku bo.

Oluvannyuma lw’emyaka esatu, twali tuzzeeyo mu maka gaffe mu Wales, nga nsomesa mu ssomero erya Grammar School ery’omu kitundu kyaffe. Abawala abamu abatiini baayitangamu ewaffe nga bava ku ssomero okudda eka, Anne kyeyava ateesa nti abayigirize akatundu ka Bayibuli omulundi gumu buli wiiki. Baakkiriza n’essanyu lingi, era mu bbanga ttono ekibinja kyagattibwamu n’abalenzi ne kikula ne kisukka mu kkumi, bwe ntyo ne nneesanga nga nze nkulembera, nga ntegeka okuyiga kwa Bayibuli era nga ntegeka n’emirimu emirala.

Oluvannyuma lw’emyaka ebiri, twali tulabye abavubuka bangi ab’emyaka wakati wa kkumi na munaana ne abiri mu munaana nga bajja eri Mukama mu kukkiriza. Ekkanisa bbiri mu kibuga kyaffe zaali ziddiddemu obulamu, era ekyo kyakwata nnyo ku bantu ab’omu bitundu ebyetoolodde. Si kuba nti nnali mubuulizi wa Njiri - nedda n’akatono, naye abavubuka baakulembera mikwano gyabwe okukkiriza Kristo, nze ne mba ‘musumba’ waabwe bumusumba, ng’abakadde b’ekkanisa yaffe bampadde eddembe eryamala okukola kye nsiima. Emyaka egyaddirira, omu ku bavubuka abo, kati ali mu buweereza bwa Mukama obw’ekiseera kyonna, yagamba nti “Twali mu kuzuukuka kw’eddiini, so nga tetukitegeera!”

Kyali kya bulijjo gye tuli okulaba abakkiriza abapya mu wiiki ezisinga. Nnalyanga, ne nnywa, ne nneebaka, ne mbeera mu mulimu gw’abavubuka, mu buli kaseera ke nnafunanga mu lunaku, - era saakoowanga n’akatono! - (era saawuliranga nti neetaaga kusasulwa!)

Bwe nnafuuka omusumba emyaka mingi oluvannyuma, Anne yabuuzibwa njawulo ki eziriwo mu kuba mukyala wa musumba kati, ng’amaze ebbanga ddene ng’ali mukyala wa musomesa. Yaddamu nti kati nnali nkola ekiseera kyonna ekyo kye nnali mmaze ebiseera byange byonna eby’okwewummulamu nga nkola!

Waabangawo ebiseera, oluvannyuma lw’olunaku olukooya ku mulimu, lwe nnazuukusibwanga mu kitanda kyange mu ttumbi ly’ekiro kubanga omu ku bavubuka yali ayitamu ekizibu era ng’ayetaaga obuyambi - kaakano! Nnayambalanga empale yange ku ngoye zange ez’okwebaka, ne nnyingira mu mmotoka yange ne ŋŋenda okunoonya omuvubuka oyo ali mu kizibu, ne nkomawo eka oluvannyuma lw’essaawa eziwerako, ne nneesogga mu kitanda okwebakako katono nga sinnagenda ku ssomero. Ekyewuunyisa kyali nti akawungeezi akaddako saabanga mukooye, era saawuliranga nti neetaaga kwebaka mangu okuliyirira otulo. Kino kyaliwo emirundi egiwerako okutuusa lwe twategeera nti kwali kuzzibwamu amaanyi okutali kwa bulijjo okuva eri Mukama.

Yesu yagamba nti “Mujje gye ndi mmwe mwenna abakooye era abazitoowereddwa, nange nnaabawummuza. Musitule ekikoligo kyange, muyigire ku nze, kubanga ndi muwombeefu era omuteefu mu mutima, n’emyoyo gyammwe girifuna ekiwummulo. Kubanga ekikoligo kyange kyangu, n’omugugu gwange teguzitowa.”

Nnali nteekwa okubuulira ebiwungeezi bina mu kkanisa nnene mu Brazil. Omusumba eyali ansembezza yajja ku kifo kya YWAM we nnali nsula, okuntwala mu mmotoka ye okutuuka mu kkanisa ye. Yali wa myaka nga kitundu ky’egyange, omuntu ow’ekisa ennyo era ng’ayogera Olungereza bulungi nnyo.

“Omusumba Gareth” bwe yagamba, “Osobola otya okugenda mu maaso ng’okola n’amaanyi bw’otyo?” “Olabika ng’olina amaanyi agatakoma, so nga nze nkooye olw’okukulembera ekkanisa yange.” Yeeyongera okunnyonnyola nga bwe yabanga mu kkanisa buli nkya ku ssaawa 6.30am okusaba, era nga tatuuka ka buli kawungeezi okutuusa nga ssaawa 11pm ziyiseewo, ng’amaze okusiba ekizimbe oluvannyuma lw’olukuŋŋaana (olwa buli kiro).

Bwe nnamala okumukakasa nti nange nkoowa, kyenva neetaaga okuwummulako emisana, ne mmubuuza nti kkanisa y’ani gy’ali azimba. “Kale, ya Mukama nga bwe kiri!” bwe yaddamu. Ne mmugamba nti si kkanisa ya Mukama gye yali azimba, wabula eyiye ye, kubanga Mukama yennyini yagamba nti ‘Ekikoligo kyange kyangu, n’omugugu gwange teguzitowa . ’ Sitegeera ngeri ki abasumba abangi bwe batyo gye bakutukamu mu mibiri, so nga bakola wamu ne Kristo - nga basibiddwa naye mu kikoligo kimu - era ng’omugugu gwe teguzitowa! Mbeegayiridde temuŋŋamba nti bulijjo kiba lwa kubanga Setaani abalumba olw’ekifo kyabwe eky’obusumba bwokka! Teyeetaaga kubalumba nga bagezaako okuzimba obwakabaka bwa Katonda n’amaanyi gaabwe ne pulogulaamu zaabwe. Ekkanisa ng’eyo tagitya! Atya kkanisa eyo yokka Yesu gye yayogerako nti, “Ndizimba Ekkanisa YANGE, n’amaanyi gonna aga Setaani tegaligiwangula!”

Nnawa mukwano gwange ow’e Brazil amagezi nti kyandibadde kirungi singa yeewaayo okuta abalala mu kibiina kye bayambeko okwetikka omugugu, nga Mukama bwe yali abategese era bwe yali abagendereddemu. Olw’okukola omulimu gwonna yekka, yali aziyiza ebigendererwa bya Mukama eri ekibiina ekyo.

Omugugu gwe yennyini n’ekirabo kye ekyeyoleka byali mu kukulembera okusinza, naye obunyigirizi bw’emirimu emirala gyonna gye yawulira nti ateekwa okukola ng’omusumba, bwamunyaga essanyu lye yandifunye ng’aweereza mu kirabo kye, era ne bunyaga ekkanisa omukisa ogw’okuyingira mu maaso ga Mukama okuyita mu kutendereza n’okusinza okuliko amafuta.

Bwe tuba tusibiddwa naye mu kikoligo kimu, tugabana omugugu gwe. Omugugu gwe gye ndi gwali buweereza bw’abavubuka; eri omutume Pawulo gwali kubuulira Enjiri eri Abaamawanga; eri Jacky Pullinger gwali bantu abawangaalira ku biragalalagala mu The Walled City, Kowloon; eri Hudson Taylor gwali bantu abatannamanya Katonda ab’omu China; eri John Wesley gwali bantu ab’omu Bungereza abatagenda mu kkanisa; eri Chuck Colsen gwali basibe ab’omu makomera ga Amerika; eri .............

Omugugu gwe eri GGWE guli ki?

Alina omugugu gw’akuteekeddewo, era akulindiridde ogwetikke. Eky’ennaku, bangi abalina emigugu emizito mu mulimu gwa Mukama batera okusuubira abalala okugyetikka. “Ogwo mulimu gwa musumba! Lwaki takolako kintu? Waliwo ekizibu eky’amaanyi mu kibuga kino eky’ebibinja by’abavubuka abazirankonyo. Lwaki ekkanisa tekolako kintu?” Lwaki ggwe tokolako kintu? Kya lwatu, tulagirwa okwetikkiragana emigugu - ‘Muyambaganenga’ (Abaggalatiya 6:2) - egyo bwe giba obuzito bw’ennaku, naye omugugu bwe guba gwa buweereza oguva eri Mukama, ‘buli muntu aneetikkanga obuvunaanyizibwa bwe’ (Abaggalatiya 6:5). Bwe tugezaako okutikka abalala emigugu gyaffe, tuba tukola nga Abafalisaayo ab’omu biseera bya Yesu. Baabanga bulijjo bagamba abalala kye basaanidde okukola, Yesu kyeyava abayogerako nti, “Basiba emigugu emizito ne bagitikka abalala.”

Omuntu omulala bw’akutikka omugugu gwe ogw’obuweereza, guyinza okuzitowa nnyo; omugugu Yesu gw’akuteekeddewo gwokka gwe gunaaba ‘Mwangu’.

Nga kya nnaku nti ffe abakulembeze b’ekkanisa twe tusooka okutikka abalala ‘omugugu gwaffe’, oluusi nga tukozesa obukuusa, okuwaanawaana, oba okubawa omusango, okubakkirizisa okukola bye twagala.

“John, twetaaga omusomesa omulala ow’essomero lya Ssande, era nkikkiriza nti ggwe muntu atuukiridde omulimu ogwo!” John bw’aba nga ye ‘muntu atuukiridde,’ asaanidde n’okubeera n’omugugu gw’omulimu ogwo.

“Mary, ekibinja ky’abakyala kitandika okukyalira amaka nnyumba ku nnyumba okuyita abantu mu nkuŋŋaana zaffe. Nkakasa nti tuyinza okukwesiga nti tojja kutulemesa.”

Kya lwatu, John ne Mary bwe basabibwa okukola ‘obuweereza’ obwo, bulijjo basobola okukkiriza, ne bwe baba tebalina ‘mugugu,’ ng’ekikolwa eky’obwesigwa mu kuweereza ekkanisa (era tusuubira, ne Mukama), naye bateekwa okwegendereza baleme kwesiba mu bisuubizo ebiyinza okuziyiza Mukama okubayita mu buweereza obulala, obuli omugugu gwe ogw’amazima n’ekigendererwa kye eri bo. John ayinza okuddamu nti, “Yee, musumba, nzija kuba mwetegefu okusomesa ekibiina ky’essomero lya Ssande okumala akaseera. Nzija kwewaayo okumala emyezi esatu egiddako, nga kiyinza okuddibwamu emirundi emirala egya myezi esatu esatu, okutuusa Mukama lw’anaakintegeeza bulungi nti alina obuweereza obulala obusinga okutuukagana n’omugugu gwange.” Eky’ennaku, abasumba bangi kino bakitwala ng’obutali bwewaayo! Eri ani?

Jim yali muvubuka alina omugugu. Buli wiikendi, ye ne mikwano gye babiri baasabanga ekiro kyonna eky’Olwokutaano, ne balyoka bamala olunaku oluddako ku nguudo z’ekibuga kyaffe, nga bajulira eri buli muntu gwe baasobolanga okunyumyako naye. Abasumba baassangamu ekitiibwa omulimu gwa Jim, era baali basanyufu okumukkiriza okwetaba mu nkuŋŋaana zaabwe ez’abaweereza eza buli mwezi, newankubadde nga yali tali wa kkanisa yonna ey’omu kitundu era nga tagigendamu. Mu butuufu, yali munyoomi nnyo bwe kituukanga ku kwogera ku kkanisa z’ekibuga kyaffe. “Bonna bazannya buzannyi! Tewali n’omu ku bo afaayo ddala ku mulimu ogw’amazima ogw’okusaba, okwegayiririra abalala n’okubuulira Enjiri!” bwe yagambanga emirundi mingi eri buli eyamuwulirizanga.

Ssande emu, Roger yajja mu kusinza kwaffe okw’oku makya ga Ssande. Teyali amanyi bingi ku ‘mpisa ennungi’ ez’enkuŋŋaana z’ekkanisa, naye yali ayakaayakana n’ebbugumu ly’enkolagana ye empya ddala ne Mukama.

“Jim yankulembedde eri Kristo ekiro kya jjo,” bwe yaŋŋamba, “era yankakasizza nti nzije mu kkanisa eno nkangavvulwe!” Nnamunnyonnyola enjawulo eri wakati w’okukangavvulwa n’okufuulibwa omuyigirizwa.

Bwe nnaddamu okulaba Jim, nnayogera ku Roger, ne nnyongerako, nga mmwenya, nti kyalabika nga Jim kati yali mu mulimu gw’okuzaala abaana ab’ebweru, ng’abazaalira ku luguudo, naye ng’asuubira abalala okubakuza! Kino kyakwata ku Jim ddala, kubanga Ssande eyaddako yali mu kusinza kwaffe. Yabangawo wiiki ttaano eziddako, okutuusa lumu lwe twasisinkana ku ky’emisana.

“Kiki ekiri ku mutima gwo ennaku zino?” bwe nnabuuza.

“Kye kimu nga bulijjo - okusaba n’okwegayiririra abalala” bwe yaddamu.

“Olowooza ki ku bulamu bw’okusaba obw’ekkanisa yaffe?” “Sirowoozaako bingi! Tewali n’omu eyo alabika ng’afaayo ku kusaba okuwangula!” “Oo” bwe nnagamba, “mmanyi omusajja mu kkanisa yaffe alina omugugu gw’okusaba ogw’amazima. Obuwanvu bwe kumpi mita bbiri, alina enviiri enkwafu, era...” Jim yeeyagula omutwe nga nneeyongera okumunnyonnyola, ng’agezaako okulowooza omusajja oyo gw’ayinza okuba, okutuusa lwe nnayongerako nti yalina akatale ke akatono ng’omukubi w’ebifaananyi eby’obusuubuzi. “Naye oyo nze!” bwe yagamba, ng’antunuulira ng’alowooza nti nfiiriddwa amagezi.

“Kituufu!” bwe nnaleekaana. “Bwe kiri! Mbuulira Jim, lwaki Katonda akuwadde omugugu guno naye ng’oyagala nze ngwetikke? Nnina omugugu gwange gwe nneetikka mu mulimu gwa Mukama, era nkwetaaga okwetikka omugugu gwo ogw’okusaba ku lwange, ndyoke nsobole okwetikka omugugu gwange obulungi.”

“Kale nkole ki?” Jim bwe yabuuza.

“Ggwe osaanidde okumbuulira, so si nze kukubuulira. Ggwe alina omugugu, era omugugu ogwo bwe guba nga guva ddala eri Mukama, ye y’asaanidde okutubuulira engeri gy’onaagwetikkamu!”

“Abantu beetaaga okuyigirizibwa okusaba.”

“Kale, onookikola ddi?”

“Ki? Nze?”

“Yee, ggwe! Ggwe alina omugugu! Onootandika ddi okuyigiriza abantu okusaba?”

“Wiiki ejja?”

“Kale!”

Wiiki eyaddako Jim yatandika ekibiina, ekyalimu abantu abamu abakulu mu kibiina kyange n’abayizi abamu okuva mu Yunivasite y’omu kitundu, abaali bawulidde ku njigiriza ezo nga zirangirirwa ku ssomero. Oluvannyuma lw’okuyigirizibwa, abantu baatandika okusaba n’okwegayiririra abalala n’obunyiikivu, nga bagoberera ‘enkola’ Jim gye yali abayigirizza. Twali tuyingira mu mukwano ogw’oku lusegere ne Mukama era nga tuwulira eddoboozi ly’Omwoyo, nga litukulembera mu kusabira ebintu ebiri ku mutima gwa Mukama.

Mu mwaka gumu, ekibiina kyali kyeyongedde emirundi ebiri, abakadde baali balonze omusumba omubeezi, ekizimbe ekipya ddala kyali kimaliriziddwa nga kituuza abantu nga ebikumi bisatu, era nga kumpi kyonna kimaze okusasulirwa! Abakulembeze b’ekitundu ky’ekkanisa yange balowooza nti nnakola omulimu munene mu kkanisa eyo, eyali ebadde n’abantu abatono mu kusinza okumala emyaka egiwerako, naye mmanyi ekyaliwo - ne ggwe kati okimanyi. Kye nnali nkoze kyokka kwali kuta mpungu ebuuke!

Mukama yali atikkidde Jim omugugu gwe kubanga yali ayagala okumukozesa okuzimba abantu be. Bwe yateebwa mu buweereza, Katonda n’afuka amafuta ku mulimu ogwo.

Omugugu Gwo

Kiki ekisinga okuzitowa ku mutima gwo? Ggwe wekka asobola okuddamu ekibuuzo ekyo, newankubadde abalala bayinza okukuyamba okukinnyonnyola obulungi.

Bw’oba tolina mugugu gukwatagana na mulimu gw’Obwakabaka, nkwegayiridde saba Mukama akuwe ogumu era agukutegeeze. Bwe nnasaba Mukama omugugu gwange ogw’abavubuka, nnali sinnaba kutegeera nga bwe ntegeera kati nti omugugu gwe ‘teguzitowa.’ Okusaba kwange kwalimu ebigambo nti saasaba kuba musanyufu nga nneetikka omugugu, wabula okumanya nti, olugendo lwange ku nsi bwe luliggwa, ndimuwulira ng’agamba nti, “Weebale, oli muddu mulungi era mwesigwa!” Saafuna busanyufu bwa bulijjo - mu butuufu waaliwo ebintu bingi ebitaali bya ssanyu bye nnayitamu - naye ddala nnafuna essanyu n’okumatizibwa mu mugugu ogwo.

Bwe ntunuulira obuweereza bwa Yesu, kyeyoleka nti omugugu gwe gwa nkolagana - gwa bantu. Yagamba nti yafukibwako amafuta okubuulira abaavu Enjiri, okubuulira abasibe okuteebwa, okuzibula abazibe b’amaaso, okusumulula abanyigirizibwa, n’okulangirira okutabaganyizibwa oba ekisa kya Katonda eri abantu. Okuva mu nnaku ezo, kya lwatu, tukuzizza ekkanisa okutuuka mu kifo we tulina ebizimbe ebirungi eby’okulabirira ne pulogulaamu nnyingi ezitegekeddwa obulungi, ne kiba kyangu abantu okufuuka aba mugaso mutono okusinga ebintu ebyo. Eky’ennaku, obuweereza bwaffe obungi bussa nnyo essira ku mirimu, abantu ne batwalibwa emirundi mingi ng’abasobola okusuulibwa, era bangi bakyalina ebiwundu eby’amaanyi okuva mu bye baayitamu.

Kikafuuwe nze okugamba nti tosaanidde kuba na mugugu gwa kulabirira nnyumba ya Katonda nnungi, naye jjukira nti ekigendererwa kyayo bulijjo kiteekwa okuba okuleeta abasajja n’abakazi mu nkolagana ne Mukama esingako obuziba.

Luno lukalala lw’emigugu egimu, Mukama gw’ayinza okukutikka ogumu ku gyo.

Mu kibiina: okuyigiriza Bayibuli; abaana; ekizimbe ky’ekkanisa; obuyonjo; amazina; obudiikoni; obukadde bw’ekkanisa; okubuulira Enjiri; ensimbi; ebimuli; abafumbo; emirimu gy’obuminsani; ennyimba; abakkiriza abapya; okutuukirira abantu ab’ebweru; okutendereza & okusinza; okusaba & okwegayiririra abalala; abakadde; abatali bafumbo; obubinja obutono; essomero lya Ssande; obumu; okwaniriza abantu; abavubuka; … Mu Bantu: ; Abaakosebwa okuggyamu embuto; amaduuka g’omu kitundu; ekifo ekitundirwamu kaawa; obutonde bw’ensi; amaka go; gavumenti y’ekitundu oba ey’eggwanga; abantu ab’ebika ebitono; obwamalaaya; amasomero g’omu kitundu; emizannyo; abantu ab’oku nguudo; ebifo ebigabira abaavu emmere; eddembe ly’abakazi; ekifo ky’omulimu… gattako egigyo.
fields.body_text: Nkyajjukira bulungi akawungeezi we nnasabira Mukama ampe omugugu gw’abavubuka. Nnali musomesa mu ssomero ly’Eggye lya Bungereza (British Forces) mu Bugirimaani, era nnali mpulira nti obujulirwa bwange obw’akamwa eri abayizi bwali tebumala, kyennava nkaabirira mu kusaba nsabe omugugu gwe nnalowooza nti gwandimpadde amaanyi ag’okujulira ennyo. Saalaba kyanzibwa kyonna amangu ago, naye nnafuna obuvumu obusingako mu kwogera n’abamu ku bo. Oluvannyuma lw’emyaka esatu, twali tuzzeeyo mu maka gaffe mu Wales, nga nsomesa mu ssomero erya Grammar School ery’omu kitundu kyaffe. Abawala abamu abatiini baayitangamu ewaffe nga bava ku ssomero okudda eka, Anne kyeyava ateesa nti abayigirize akatundu ka Bayibuli omulundi gumu buli wiiki. Baakkiriza n’essanyu lingi, era mu bbanga ttono ekibinja kyagattibwamu n’abalenzi ne kikula ne kisukka mu kkumi, bwe ntyo ne nneesanga nga nze nkulembera, nga ntegeka okuyiga kwa Bayibuli era nga ntegeka n’emirimu emirala. Oluvannyuma lw’emyaka ebiri, twali tulabye abavubuka bangi ab’emyaka wakati wa kkumi na munaana ne abiri mu munaana nga bajja eri Mukama mu kukkiriza. Ekkanisa bbiri mu kibuga kyaffe zaali ziddiddemu obulamu, era ekyo kyakwata nnyo ku bantu ab’omu bitundu ebyetoolodde. Si kuba nti nnali mubuulizi wa Njiri - nedda n’akatono, naye abavubuka baakulembera mikwano gyabwe okukkiriza Kristo, nze ne mba ‘musumba’ waabwe bumusumba, ng’abakadde b’ekkanisa yaffe bampadde eddembe eryamala okukola kye nsiima. Emyaka egyaddirira, omu ku bavubuka abo, kati ali mu buweereza bwa Mukama obw’ekiseera kyonna, yagamba nti “Twali mu kuzuukuka kw’eddiini, so nga tetukitegeera!” Kyali kya bulijjo gye tuli okulaba abakkiriza abapya mu wiiki ezisinga. Nnalyanga, ne nnywa, ne nneebaka, ne mbeera mu mulimu gw’abavubuka, mu buli kaseera ke nnafunanga mu lunaku, - era saakoowanga n’akatono! - (era saawuliranga nti neetaaga kusasulwa!) Bwe nnafuuka omusumba emyaka mingi oluvannyuma, Anne yabuuzibwa njawulo ki eziriwo mu kuba mukyala wa musumba kati, ng’amaze ebbanga ddene ng’ali mukyala wa musomesa. Yaddamu nti kati nnali nkola ekiseera kyonna ekyo kye nnali mmaze ebiseera byange byonna eby’okwewummulamu nga nkola! Waabangawo ebiseera, oluvannyuma lw’olunaku olukooya ku mulimu, lwe nnazuukusibwanga mu kitanda kyange mu ttumbi ly’ekiro kubanga omu ku bavubuka yali ayitamu ekizibu era ng’ayetaaga obuyambi - kaakano! Nnayambalanga empale yange ku ngoye zange ez’okwebaka, ne nnyingira mu mmotoka yange ne ŋŋenda okunoonya omuvubuka oyo ali mu kizibu, ne nkomawo eka oluvannyuma lw’essaawa eziwerako, ne nneesogga mu kitanda okwebakako katono nga sinnagenda ku ssomero. Ekyewuunyisa kyali nti akawungeezi akaddako saabanga mukooye, era saawuliranga nti neetaaga kwebaka mangu okuliyirira otulo. Kino kyaliwo emirundi egiwerako okutuusa lwe twategeera nti kwali kuzzibwamu amaanyi okutali kwa bulijjo okuva eri Mukama. Yesu yagamba nti “Mujje gye ndi mmwe mwenna abakooye era abazitoowereddwa, nange nnaabawummuza. Musitule ekikoligo kyange, muyigire ku nze, kubanga ndi muwombeefu era omuteefu mu mutima, n’emyoyo gyammwe girifuna ekiwummulo. Kubanga ekikoligo kyange kyangu, n’omugugu gwange teguzitowa.” Nnali nteekwa okubuulira ebiwungeezi bina mu kkanisa nnene mu Brazil. Omusumba eyali ansembezza yajja ku kifo kya YWAM we nnali nsula, okuntwala mu mmotoka ye okutuuka mu kkanisa ye. Yali wa myaka nga kitundu ky’egyange, omuntu ow’ekisa ennyo era ng’ayogera Olungereza bulungi nnyo. “Omusumba Gareth” bwe yagamba, “Osobola otya okugenda mu maaso ng’okola n’amaanyi bw’otyo?” “Olabika ng’olina amaanyi agatakoma, so nga nze nkooye olw’okukulembera ekkanisa yange.” Yeeyongera okunnyonnyola nga bwe yabanga mu kkanisa buli nkya ku ssaawa 6.30am okusaba, era nga tatuuka ka buli kawungeezi okutuusa nga ssaawa 11pm ziyiseewo, ng’amaze okusiba ekizimbe oluvannyuma lw’olukuŋŋaana (olwa buli kiro). Bwe nnamala okumukakasa nti nange nkoowa, kyenva neetaaga okuwummulako emisana, ne mmubuuza nti kkanisa y’ani gy’ali azimba. “Kale, ya Mukama nga bwe kiri!” bwe yaddamu. Ne mmugamba nti si kkanisa ya Mukama gye yali azimba, wabula eyiye ye, kubanga Mukama yennyini yagamba nti ‘Ekikoligo kyange kyangu, n’omugugu gwange teguzitowa . ’ Sitegeera ngeri ki abasumba abangi bwe batyo gye bakutukamu mu mibiri, so nga bakola wamu ne Kristo - nga basibiddwa naye mu kikoligo kimu - era ng’omugugu gwe teguzitowa! Mbeegayiridde temuŋŋamba nti bulijjo kiba lwa kubanga Setaani abalumba olw’ekifo kyabwe eky’obusumba bwokka! Teyeetaaga kubalumba nga bagezaako okuzimba obwakabaka bwa Katonda n’amaanyi gaabwe ne pulogulaamu zaabwe. Ekkanisa ng’eyo tagitya! Atya kkanisa eyo yokka Yesu gye yayogerako nti, “Ndizimba Ekkanisa YANGE, n’amaanyi gonna aga Setaani tegaligiwangula!” Nnawa mukwano gwange ow’e Brazil amagezi nti kyandibadde kirungi singa yeewaayo okuta abalala mu kibiina kye bayambeko okwetikka omugugu, nga Mukama bwe yali abategese era bwe yali abagendereddemu. Olw’okukola omulimu gwonna yekka, yali aziyiza ebigendererwa bya Mukama eri ekibiina ekyo. Omugugu gwe yennyini n’ekirabo kye ekyeyoleka byali mu kukulembera okusinza, naye obunyigirizi bw’emirimu emirala gyonna gye yawulira nti ateekwa okukola ng’omusumba, bwamunyaga essanyu lye yandifunye ng’aweereza mu kirabo kye, era ne bunyaga ekkanisa omukisa ogw’okuyingira mu maaso ga Mukama okuyita mu kutendereza n’okusinza okuliko amafuta. Bwe tuba tusibiddwa naye mu kikoligo kimu, tugabana omugugu gwe. Omugugu gwe gye ndi gwali buweereza bw’abavubuka; eri omutume Pawulo gwali kubuulira Enjiri eri Abaamawanga; eri Jacky Pullinger gwali bantu abawangaalira ku biragalalagala mu The Walled City, Kowloon; eri Hudson Taylor gwali bantu abatannamanya Katonda ab’omu China; eri John Wesley gwali bantu ab’omu Bungereza abatagenda mu kkanisa; eri Chuck Colsen gwali basibe ab’omu makomera ga Amerika; eri ............. Omugugu gwe eri GGWE guli ki? Alina omugugu gw’akuteekeddewo, era akulindiridde ogwetikke. Eky’ennaku, bangi abalina emigugu emizito mu mulimu gwa Mukama batera okusuubira abalala okugyetikka. “Ogwo mulimu gwa musumba! Lwaki takolako kintu? Waliwo ekizibu eky’amaanyi mu kibuga kino eky’ebibinja by’abavubuka abazirankonyo. Lwaki ekkanisa tekolako kintu?” Lwaki ggwe tokolako kintu? Kya lwatu, tulagirwa okwetikkiragana emigugu - ‘Muyambaganenga’ (Abaggalatiya 6:2) - egyo bwe giba obuzito bw’ennaku, naye omugugu bwe guba gwa buweereza oguva eri Mukama, ‘buli muntu aneetikkanga obuvunaanyizibwa bwe’ (Abaggalatiya 6:5). Bwe tugezaako okutikka abalala emigugu gyaffe, tuba tukola nga Abafalisaayo ab’omu biseera bya Yesu. Baabanga bulijjo bagamba abalala kye basaanidde okukola, Yesu kyeyava abayogerako nti, “Basiba emigugu emizito ne bagitikka abalala.” Omuntu omulala bw’akutikka omugugu gwe ogw’obuweereza, guyinza okuzitowa nnyo; omugugu Yesu gw’akuteekeddewo gwokka gwe gunaaba ‘Mwangu’. Nga kya nnaku nti ffe abakulembeze b’ekkanisa twe tusooka okutikka abalala ‘omugugu gwaffe’, oluusi nga tukozesa obukuusa, okuwaanawaana, oba okubawa omusango, okubakkirizisa okukola bye twagala. “John, twetaaga omusomesa omulala ow’essomero lya Ssande, era nkikkiriza nti ggwe muntu atuukiridde omulimu ogwo!” John bw’aba nga ye ‘muntu atuukiridde,’ asaanidde n’okubeera n’omugugu gw’omulimu ogwo. “Mary, ekibinja ky’abakyala kitandika okukyalira amaka nnyumba ku nnyumba okuyita abantu mu nkuŋŋaana zaffe. Nkakasa nti tuyinza okukwesiga nti tojja kutulemesa.” Kya lwatu, John ne Mary bwe basabibwa okukola ‘obuweereza’ obwo, bulijjo basobola okukkiriza, ne bwe baba tebalina ‘mugugu,’ ng’ekikolwa eky’obwesigwa mu kuweereza ekkanisa (era tusuubira, ne Mukama), naye bateekwa okwegendereza baleme kwesiba mu bisuubizo ebiyinza okuziyiza Mukama okubayita mu buweereza obulala, obuli omugugu gwe ogw’amazima n’ekigendererwa kye eri bo. John ayinza okuddamu nti, “Yee, musumba, nzija kuba mwetegefu okusomesa ekibiina ky’essomero lya Ssande okumala akaseera. Nzija kwewaayo okumala emyezi esatu egiddako, nga kiyinza okuddibwamu emirundi emirala egya myezi esatu esatu, okutuusa Mukama lw’anaakintegeeza bulungi nti alina obuweereza obulala obusinga okutuukagana n’omugugu gwange.” Eky’ennaku, abasumba bangi kino bakitwala ng’obutali bwewaayo! Eri ani? Jim yali muvubuka alina omugugu. Buli wiikendi, ye ne mikwano gye babiri baasabanga ekiro kyonna eky’Olwokutaano, ne balyoka bamala olunaku oluddako ku nguudo z’ekibuga kyaffe, nga bajulira eri buli muntu gwe baasobolanga okunyumyako naye. Abasumba baassangamu ekitiibwa omulimu gwa Jim, era baali basanyufu okumukkiriza okwetaba mu nkuŋŋaana zaabwe ez’abaweereza eza buli mwezi, newankubadde nga yali tali wa kkanisa yonna ey’omu kitundu era nga tagigendamu. Mu butuufu, yali munyoomi nnyo bwe kituukanga ku kwogera ku kkanisa z’ekibuga kyaffe. “Bonna bazannya buzannyi! Tewali n’omu ku bo afaayo ddala ku mulimu ogw’amazima ogw’okusaba, okwegayiririra abalala n’okubuulira Enjiri!” bwe yagambanga emirundi mingi eri buli eyamuwulirizanga. Ssande emu, Roger yajja mu kusinza kwaffe okw’oku makya ga Ssande. Teyali amanyi bingi ku ‘mpisa ennungi’ ez’enkuŋŋaana z’ekkanisa, naye yali ayakaayakana n’ebbugumu ly’enkolagana ye empya ddala ne Mukama. “Jim yankulembedde eri Kristo ekiro kya jjo,” bwe yaŋŋamba, “era yankakasizza nti nzije mu kkanisa eno nkangavvulwe!” Nnamunnyonnyola enjawulo eri wakati w’okukangavvulwa n’okufuulibwa omuyigirizwa. Bwe nnaddamu okulaba Jim, nnayogera ku Roger, ne nnyongerako, nga mmwenya, nti kyalabika nga Jim kati yali mu mulimu gw’okuzaala abaana ab’ebweru, ng’abazaalira ku luguudo, naye ng’asuubira abalala okubakuza! Kino kyakwata ku Jim ddala, kubanga Ssande eyaddako yali mu kusinza kwaffe. Yabangawo wiiki ttaano eziddako, okutuusa lumu lwe twasisinkana ku ky’emisana. “Kiki ekiri ku mutima gwo ennaku zino?” bwe nnabuuza. “Kye kimu nga bulijjo - okusaba n’okwegayiririra abalala” bwe yaddamu. “Olowooza ki ku bulamu bw’okusaba obw’ekkanisa yaffe?” “Sirowoozaako bingi! Tewali n’omu eyo alabika ng’afaayo ku kusaba okuwangula!” “Oo” bwe nnagamba, “mmanyi omusajja mu kkanisa yaffe alina omugugu gw’okusaba ogw’amazima. Obuwanvu bwe kumpi mita bbiri, alina enviiri enkwafu, era...” Jim yeeyagula omutwe nga nneeyongera okumunnyonnyola, ng’agezaako okulowooza omusajja oyo gw’ayinza okuba, okutuusa lwe nnayongerako nti yalina akatale ke akatono ng’omukubi w’ebifaananyi eby’obusuubuzi. “Naye oyo nze!” bwe yagamba, ng’antunuulira ng’alowooza nti nfiiriddwa amagezi. “Kituufu!” bwe nnaleekaana. “Bwe kiri! Mbuulira Jim, lwaki Katonda akuwadde omugugu guno naye ng’oyagala nze ngwetikke? Nnina omugugu gwange gwe nneetikka mu mulimu gwa Mukama, era nkwetaaga okwetikka omugugu gwo ogw’okusaba ku lwange, ndyoke nsobole okwetikka omugugu gwange obulungi.” “Kale nkole ki?” Jim bwe yabuuza. “Ggwe osaanidde okumbuulira, so si nze kukubuulira. Ggwe alina omugugu, era omugugu ogwo bwe guba nga guva ddala eri Mukama, ye y’asaanidde okutubuulira engeri gy’onaagwetikkamu!” “Abantu beetaaga okuyigirizibwa okusaba.” “Kale, onookikola ddi?” “Ki? Nze?” “Yee, ggwe! Ggwe alina omugugu! Onootandika ddi okuyigiriza abantu okusaba?” “Wiiki ejja?” “Kale!” Wiiki eyaddako Jim yatandika ekibiina, ekyalimu abantu abamu abakulu mu kibiina kyange n’abayizi abamu okuva mu Yunivasite y’omu kitundu, abaali bawulidde ku njigiriza ezo nga zirangirirwa ku ssomero. Oluvannyuma lw’okuyigirizibwa, abantu baatandika okusaba n’okwegayiririra abalala n’obunyiikivu, nga bagoberera ‘enkola’ Jim gye yali abayigirizza. Twali tuyingira mu mukwano ogw’oku lusegere ne Mukama era nga tuwulira eddoboozi ly’Omwoyo, nga litukulembera mu kusabira ebintu ebiri ku mutima gwa Mukama.
