Embeera eya bulijjo eyinza okuba bw’eti: Omusumba: Waliwo gwe mulaba ng’ateekeddeteekedde okusumululwa okuyingira mu buweereza? Omukadde (Abakadde): Tubadde twetegereza nnyo Mary okuva ku lukiiko lwaffe olwayita. Kyeyoleka nti afaayo nnyo ku by’obuminsani, era okusaba kwe olw’abo abazikirira kulaga okufaayo okw’amaanyi. Mukkiriza eyeewaddeyo, omwesigwa mu kuwaayo ebyensimbi ne mu kubeerawo mu nkuŋŋaana. Twandyagadde akakiiko kamuyite atubuulire omugugu gwe, ng’aleeta n’ekiteeso, tulyoke tulabe ffe, ng’amaka g’ekkanisa, bwe tuyinza okuddamu ekiteeso ekyo. Mary bw’ajja mu maaso g’abakadde n’ekiteeso kye, kiyinza okusoboka okutandikawo obuweereza obuwagira omugugu gwe. Embeera endala: Omusumba: John mumulaba mutya mu kukula kwe ng’ayinza okuba omukadde w’ekkanisa? Omukadde (Abakadde): Ddala aweebwa ekitiibwa kinene mu bantu abasinga obungi mu kkanisa. Mmanyi nti bangi ku bo bagenda gy’ali okufuna amagezi, era okuwabula kwe kutuufu. Ategeera bulungi Ekigambo era abeera obulamu obutuukana n’ebiragiro byakyo. Omusumba: ‘Atuukiriza ebisaanyizo’ okusinziira ku Byawandiikibwa? (Tito ne 1 Timoseewo) Omukadde (Abakadde): Tukkiriza nti bwe kiri. Omusumba: Kale tumuyite ku lukiiko lw’akakiiko oluddako, tumuteeke ‘ku kugezesebwa’ ng’omukadde okumala emyezi omukaaga egiddako. Jim, onoomutwala ng’oli naye n’oba omuluŋŋamya we? Bw’anaakakasa okuyitibwa kwe, tujja kumwanjula eri ekibiina ku lukiiko lwa buli mwaka oluddako. Embeera eziyinza okubaawo nnyingi - ziwera ng’abantu ab’enjawulo abali mu kkanisa yo Mukama b’ayagala okusumulula okuyingira mu buweereza bwe. Wuliriza Kikulu nnyo ffe abasumba okuwuliriza abantu baffe nga bayogera ku migugu gyabwe. Tusaanidde okusobola okubayamba okutangaaza okwolesebwa kwabwe katono, balyoke bategeere ddala era balambulule omugugu ogwo. Mubakubirize, mubazzeemu amaanyi, naye okusinga byonna, mubawulirize. Omugugu gwabwe oguva eri Mukama gwe tufaako, so si mugugu gwaffe gwe twandyagadde batuyambe okwetikka. Mubayambe okwogera omugugu mu bigambo. Kakasa ebirabo byabwe Omugugu bwe guba gutegeerekese, noonya okumanya okuva eri abalala obanga obusobozi, ebitone n’ebirabo eby’Omwoyo ebyetaagisa okwetikka omugugu ogwo mu buweereza biri mu bulamu bwa mmemba ono. Okuyamba mu kino, omuntu ayinza okukozesa emu ku bibuuzo ebingi ebikwata ku birabo n’embeera z’obuntu ebisangibwa nnyo leero. Kya lwatu, tetusaanidde kusuubira kulaba mafuta oba obukulu bw’obukulembeze mu ‘mpungu etannasumululwa kubuuka’! Bajja kutya, naawe ojja kuba n’okweraliikirira, naye maama ki atakikola bw’alaba abaana be nga batambula entambula zaabwe ezisooka ennafu ez’okwesittala? Olwo abika omwana we nate n’agaana okumuleka kugezaako kutambula alemenga okwesittala? Nedda n’akatono! Naawe, eyayitibwa okulabirira endiga ze, tokikola. Tandika okusumulula Omukkiriza omulamu bw’aba n’omugugu ogutegeerekeka, era obujulizi bw’obusobozi n’ebirabo nga buliwo era nga bukakasiddwa bangi, kiba kiseera kya kusumulula mpungu. Teekawo ekiseera ekirungi okubeera naye. Tosaanidde kuba na nteekateeka za mbereberye za lukiiko luno, wadde ekigendererwa eky’okuteeka omugugu gwo ku bibegabega bye. Kikulu nnyo olukiiko luno lwesigame ku mmemba n’okutambula kwe ne Mukama, so si ku kkanisa ne pulogulaamu zaayo. Pulogulaamu za kkanisa yo bwe ziba ziva eri Mukama, Ye asobola ddala okutegeka abakulembeze abeetaagisa ng’abateekako omugugu ogubasaanira - omugugu gwe ogutazitowa. Ku nkomerero y’olukiiko luno, ggwe ne mmemba mwembi musaanidde okuba nga mutegeera bulungi omugugu n’okwegomba obuweereza okuli ku mutima gwa mmemba. Kiyinza obutasoboka kutuukiriza kwegomba kwe kwonna okw’obuweereza - kuyinza okusukka ekkanisa ky’esobola okukola, oba obutasoboka olw’abakozi oba ebyensimbi. Kyokka kaakano mwembi mulina kye mukolerako. Endagaano y’Obuweereza Bw’olaba obuweereza obuyinza okuggulirwawo empungu ento, bwogereko naye okulaba obanga mukkiriziganya. Nteesa nti olwo okole Endagaano y’Obuweereza nga mwogeraganya ne mmemba. Kino kiyinza okutwala wiiki nga bbiri okukiteekateeka, ye naawe (abakadde) mulyoke mukkiriziganye mu bujjuvu. Oyinza n’okuba n’akabinja k’abantu abatono obuweereza bwabwe kwe kuwandiika endagaano z’obuweereza ez’engeri eyo, ggwe n’empungu ento mulyoke muzikkirize. Endagaano y’Obuweereza esaanidde okulaga bulungi ensalo z’obuweereza, obuyinza obusigiddwa n’okuvunaanibwa. Ekyokulabirako ekyangu kye kino: Susan abadde abuulira mikwano gye nti ayagala okugenda mu Ssomero ly’Okutendeka Abayigirizwa (Discipleship Training School) erya Youth With A Mission (ng’ekyokulabirako), era ali mu kwogera n’abantu kinnoomu mu kkanisa ng’agezaako okufuna obuwagizi bw’ebyensimbi olw’emyezi omukaaga gy’asuubira okumala ng’agenze. Tosanyukira nnyo kino, kubanga olowooza nti abamu mu kibiina bayinza okuba nga baggya ebimu ku biweebwayo byabwe ku pulogulaamu z’ekkanisa ne babiwa Susan. Ogenda gye bali mu kyama n’obagamba obutamuwagira? Omuyita mu ofiisi yo n’omugaana okusaba bammemba obuwagizi? Obuulira okubuulira okw’amaanyi n’okusingawo ku kuwaayo okw’obwesigwa eri ekkanisa yo? Oba weebuuza nti, “Nnyinza ntya okuyamba akaana k’empungu kano okubuuka?” Ani amanyi, oba ddala alifuuka omuminsani ow’amaanyi lumu, ng’aleetera Mukama bangi era ng’aleeta ekitiibwa kinene eri erinnya lye - ng’abuuka ng’empungu nga Mukama bwe yamutegekera. Oyinza okumuyita mu ofiisi, n’omuwa ekiseera ekirungi n’omuwuliriza ng’atikkula omugugu gwe. Tamanyi bingi ku by’obuminsani wadde ku YWAM, naye alina okwegomba okuweereza Mukama mu mbeera y’obuminsani, era ategeera obwetaavu bw’okutendekebwa olw’ekyo. Kikweyolekedde nti Susan alina obuyigirize obulungi, era mukkiriza eyeewaddeyo alina omutima ogusaasira abazikirira. Oyinza okumuteesereza okwongera okumanya YWAM n’amasomero amalala agayinza okumusaanira, nga naawe onoonya okutegeera embeera y’obuntu bwe n’ekirabo kye. Olwo endagaano y’obuweereza eno wammanga eyinza okuweebwa. Endagaano y’Obuweereza - Susan Smith Nga tutegeera nti Mukama yatuyita tugende mu nsi yonna tubuulire Enjiri, nti eby’obuminsani biri kumpi n’omutima gwe, era nti ennimiro zeeru amakungula gatuuse naye abakozi abakungula batono, Ffe, abakadde ba Westside Evangelical Church, Yourtown, tukola Endagaano y’Obuweereza eno ne Susan Smith, mmemba w’ekkanisa eno. Susan ajja kusoma mu Ssomero ly’Okutendeka Abayigirizwa (DTS) erya YWAM mu kibuga ky’ekibuga kyabwe okumala emyezi omukaaga okuva mu Jjanwali okutuuka mu Juuni, 1999. Tutegeera nti omuwendo gwonna ogw’essomero lino gujja kuba nga $5000, nga mw’otwalidde ebisulo, ebisale by’okusoma, ebyetaago bye eby’obuntu n’ensaasaanya y’okubuulira. Nga tannagenda mu ssomero, Susan ajja kuweebwa eddakiika kkumi na ttaano mu kusinza okwa Ssande ku makya okubuulira ekibiina enteekateeka ze. Ekiweebwayo eky’okwagala kijja kumukuŋŋaanyizibwa ku nkomerero y’okusinza okwo. Ekkanisa ejja kwongerako ku kino ensimbi ezimala okumusobozesa okusasulira entambula ye okutuuka mu kibuga kyabwe. Ng’ali ku ssomero, Susan ajja kuweerezanga ekkanisa kaseti (oba ebbaluwa) buli mwezi okututegeeza okugenda mu maaso kwe n’ebyetaago bye eby’okusaba. Akatundu ku kaseti eyo kajja kuzannyibwanga eri ekibiina mu kusinza okw’oku makya omulundi gumu buli mwezi, olwo n’asabirwa. Buli kibinja ky’okusaba mu kkanisa kijja kukubirizibwa okufuula okusabira Susan ekitundu ekya bulijjo eky’enkuŋŋaana zaakyo. Ebifaananyi oba obubaka bwonna Susan bw’aweereza eka bujja kuteekebwa ku lubaawo lw’eby’obuminsani olw’ekkanisa. Ekkanisa ejja kuweerezanga Susan $200 buli mwezi, ng’ogasseeko ensimbi zonna ezimukuŋŋaanyizibwa okuyita mu mirimu emirala egikolebwa bammemba baffe ebweru w’ekkanisa. Tetujja kwerabira nti Susan akyali mmemba w’ekibiina kyaffe wadde ng’ali wala okumala emyezi gino omukaaga, era abakadde beeyama okubeera nga bamuliwo mu buli kizibu oba obwetaavu bw’okuwabulwa bw’ayinza okuba nabwo ng’ali eyo. Bw’amaliriza essomero lye ery’emyezi omukaaga, Susan ajja kudda mu kkanisa eno nga tannaba kwewaayo mu buweereza bulala bwonna, ne YWAM oba ekibiina ekirala kyonna. Ajja kuvunaanibwa eri omusumba okulaga okugenda mu maaso kw’akoze ng’omuyigirizwa okuyita mu ssomero lya DTS. Ajja kwetaagibwa okusisinkana omusumba, oba omukadde asigiddwa, omulundi gumu buli mwezi okumala emyezi omukaaga egiddako. Ku nkomerero y’ekiseera ekyo, Endagaano y’Obuweereza eno ekoma. Kikkiriziddwa: Abateeseeko emikono: Susan Smith John Williams (omukadde) - ku lw’akakiiko k’abakadde Peter Smith (omusumba) * Endagaano z’Obuweereza endala ez’okulabirako zisangibwa mu Ekyongerezeddwako 2 Weeyongere okulabirira Susan bw’agenda mu ssomero lye - oba mu buweereza obuddirira - omulimu gw’omusumba guba tegunnaggwa. Ateekwa okweyongera okumuluŋŋamya, okumulabirira. Okufaayo kw’alaga mu byonna by’akola kujja kumukwata nnyo era kujja kumuzimbamu endowooza ennungi eri ekkanisa n’obukulembeze bwayo obwateekebwawo. Wajja kubaawo ebiseera lw’anaawulira okuggwaamu essuubi, n’okwetaaga omusumba okumuzzaamu omwoyo. Ajja kwetaaga amagezi ng’afuba okutuukiriza omugugu gwe. Ayinza okwetaaga omukono omunywevu ogumuziyiza okugwa mu kabi oba mu busirusiru. Yeetaaga omusumba we - kitaawe empungu - okutuusa lw’ayiga okubuuka wansi w’amafuta g’Omwoyo. Bwe kiba kisoboka, mukyalire mu kifo kye eky’obuweereza, weetegereze by’akola mu bulamu bwe obwa buli lunaku, gezaako okutegeera olutalo lw’alwana, muzzeemu amaanyi, munaaze ebigere .

fields.title: Okusumululwa
fields.body_html:
Bw’oba weetisse omugugu gw’okkiriza nti guva eri Mukama, naye nga tokyaweereza mu mugugu ogwo, oboolyawo osaanidde okunoonya okusumululwa n’obuwagizi okuva mu kkanisa yo. Nga bw’osomye mu kitabo kino okutuusa kaakano, otandika okutegeera obulumi obwo obuli munda mmwo nga gwe mugugu gwe, era kaakano weebuuza ky’osaanidde okukola ku gwo. Essuula eno ya ggwe.

1. Ekisooka ky’olina okukola kwe kutegeeza obulungi omugugu ogwo. Tekigasa kwogera na balala ku gwo ng’oyinza butabategeeza kye weefaananya era kye mubategeeza. Okugamba nti “Mpulira ennaku nnyingi olw’abamalaaya abali ku nguudo zaffe” tekiraga bulungi obanga olina omugugu gwe ku bo. Otegeeza nti oyagala ab’obuyinza baziyize abamalaaya obutalabikira mu lujjudde?

Otegeeza nti toyinza kutambula wakati mu kibuga n’abaana bo akawungeezi? Otegeeza nti okwatibwa ensonyi kubanga mikwano gyo bamanyi ekibuga kyo ng’ekifo omuli abamalaaya? Oba otegeeza nti oyagala okubatuukirira obalage obulamu obusinga obulungi obusangibwa mu Kristo? Ennaku eno, okwegomba kuno, kuyingira mu birowoozo byo ebiseera ebisinga oba kuvaayo kwokka bw’oba oli ‘wakati mu kibuga’? Mu ngeri endala, omugugu guli munda mmwo oba gukujjira kwokka ng’ebiri ebweru bikujjukiza? Omugugu ogw’amazima oguva eri Mukama gujja kufuga ebirowoozo byo, gukumme otulo, era gukukubirize okukola.

2. Weebuuze ebimu ku bibuuzo.

“Nkola dda byonna bye nsobola okukola okutuukiriza obwetaavu buno?”

Okugeza, bw’oba osanga nga kizibu nnyo okwogera n’abakazi ab’oku nguudo, obuwagizi bw’ekkanisa yo tebugenda kukyanguyiza n’akatono!

“Mmanyi nti nnina ebirabo n’obusobozi ebituukira ku buweereza bwe nnoonya?”

“Abalala baakakasa ebirabo ebyo mu nze?”

“Okusumululwa ekkanisa kwandiyongedde kutya obuweereza bwange okukola obulungi?”

“Ekkanisa eweereza dda mu kitundu kino?”

Bwe kiba bwe kityo, lwaki toli mu buweereza obwo? Okusumululwa kwo kwandyongedde ku mulimu ogwo oba kwandiguwakanyizza?

“Abakulembeze b’ekkanisa yange ab’omwoyo bammanyi bulungi okusobola okutegeera omugugu n’ebirabo byange nga biva eri Mukama?”

Tosuubira kusumululwa mu buweereza abakulembeze b’ekkanisa yo bw’oba tonnaba kwekakasa nga oli mwesigwa mu kuweereza munda mu kkanisa, nga weewaddeyo mu kussa ekimu okw’ekkanisa, nga ossaamu ekitiibwa abakulembeze b’ekkanisa era nga otegeera ebirabo eby’omwoyo n’obuweereza bw’abalala.

Lwaki abakulembeze b’ekkanisa bandikusumuludde mu buweereza ng’oba tossizza kitiibwa buyinza bwabwe mu bukulembeze? Nabo (basaanidde) okuba n’obuweereza Mukama bwe yabateekerateekera n’abawa n’ebyetaago. Bw’oba totegeera ekyo, lwaki oli mu kkanisa eyo?

Nzijukira ekiseera Dawudi kye yamala ng’adduka kabaka Sawulo eyali agudde eddalu. Dawudi yamanya nti Katonda yamufukako amafuta okuba kabaka wa Isirayeri, yali aleeteddwa mu lubiri era ateekwa okuba nga yeewuunya engeri Mukama gye yali ategekamu ekkubo mu maaso ge. Wabula, Sawulo yasigala nga kabaka wadde nga kyali kya lwatu eri bonna nti yali afiiriddwa ekisa kya Katonda era ng’asemberera eddalu.

Emirundi ebiri Dawudi yafuna omukisa omwangu ogw’okutta oyo eyali amunoonya, naye buli mulundi n’aziyiza omukono gwe ng’agamba nti, “Wadde omukulembeze wange akola bubi era anoonya okunzikiriza, wadde nga Katonda yampita okuba omukulembeze w’abantu bano, sijja kugolola mukono gwange ku oyo Mukama gwe yalonda!” (Ennukuta ezeewunzikidde zange). Yamanya nti, singa kyali kya Katonda okwagala Dawudi okutwala obwakabaka, yali asobola bulungi okukituukiriza awatali Dawudi kweyingiza!

Entalo mmeka mu kkanisa ze zandikomye, ensonyi mmeka ku mubiri gwa Kristo ze zandyewaliddwa, singa twategeera omusingi gwe gumu. Bw’oba tokkiriza nti Mukama ‘yalonda’ omusumba wo mu kifo ky’alimu, lwaki osigala mu kkanisa eyo? Oba ye ‘eyalondebwa’ Katonda ng’aweerereza we Mukama gy’amwagala (wadde ng’akola ensobi era n’atakola byonna by’olowooza nti asaanidde okukola), oba musumba ow’obulimba akubuza! Weegendereze engeri gy’omusalira omusango!

3. Tegeera enteekateeka y’obukulembeze bw’ekkanisa yo. Omanyi ani ‘akubikkako mu by’omwoyo’? Okugeza, mu kkanisa ennene, tekisoboka omusumba omukulu okumanya buli muntu, kale obuweereza obw’obusumba butera okusigirwa abakadde oba abakulembeze b’ebibinja ebitono. Omukadde wo/omukulembeze w’ekibinja ekitono alina obuyinza obumusigiddwa okwogera ku lulwo eri abo abali mu bukulembeze bw’ekkanisa abayinza okukusumulula? Ye kennyini alina obuyinza okukusumulula mu buweereza? Bw’ossa ensonga yo mu maaso ge, yandisobodde okugireeta, awamu naawe, eri abo abakisobola?

4. Wandiika ekiwandiiko ekikwata ku kwolesebwa n’omugugu gwo bwe kityo abakulembeze b’ekkanisa bategeere bulungi bw’owulira. Kino kisaanidde okuweerezebwa oba okuweebwa abakulembeze awamu n’ebbaluwa esaba akakisa okusisinkana nabo. Bw’oba tomanyidde bulungi kweyoleka mu bbaluwa, saba mukwano gwo ow’amagezi asome ebiwandiiko era akuwe amagezi ku bye birimu.

Ekiwandiiko kisaanidde era okulimu ebiteeso ku ngeri obuweereza gye buyinza okubaamu.

Oyinza okwagala okuteekamu koppi y’ekitabo kino bwe kityo abakulembeze bategeere w’oggya ebirowoozo byo! Eri bangi ku bo, kino kyandibadde ekkubo eppya kubanga tebabaddewo kulowooza ku buvunaanyizibwa bwabwe ‘okutendeka abantu ba Katonda olw’omulimu ogw’obuweereza’. Tebabangako kulowooza ku kukusumulula obuuke ng’empungu. Baayigirizibwa nti omulimu gw’obuweereza gwa basumba abaateekebwako emikono bokka. Nga kya nnaku! Nga tekigoberera Byawandiikibwa!

5. Noonya okukolera awamu n’abakulembeze b’ekkanisa yo mu kukuza obuweereza bwo ng’ovunaanibwa. Olwokubanga okkiriza okuvunaanibwa eri abo Mukama be yateeka mu Mubiri gwa Kristo okuba abakutendeka, olwo n’asobola okukuwa obuyinza obw’amafuta ge. Jjukira nti okuvunaanibwa kitegeeza okuba omwetegefu okukkiriza eky’okuddamu ekigamba ‘Nedda’ nga bw’okkiriza ‘Weewaawo’! Abakulembeze bo bayinza okuba nga bakola mu buvunaanyizibwa nnyo bwe bagamba ‘Nedda’ ku kusaba kwo kubanga bakkiriza nti tonnaba kubeera mwetegefu kusumululwa. Okyalina okwekakasa nga oli mwesigwa mu bintu ebitono, nga tosagaasagana mu kigendererwa, ng’olaga empisa n’ebirabo ebyetaagisa. Tebajja kukusindika kukuggya mu kiswa bwe balaba nga okyalina ebiwundu n’endowooza ebyandiziyizza okubuuka kwo!

Bwe kiba nga abakulembeze b’ekkanisa yo tebakkiriza buvunaanyizibwa bw’okutendeka n’okusumulula, lwe kyokka lw’oba oli waddembe okutwala omutendera 6!

6. Fuluma mu kiswa!

Awatali buwagizi bwa kkanisa yo, kino kiyinza okutiisa. Omugugu gwo bwe guba nga teguva eri Mukama, ojja kukoowa era n’oterebuka ng’olwanirira mu maanyi go bwe wekka okukozesa obuweereza buno. Ojja kukemebwa okukozesa enkola ez’ensi okufuna ‘obuwanguzi’ era okwekengera kujja kukuggyako essanyu ery’okuweereza. Ssente z’olowooza nti nzeetaagisa tezijja kwanguyirwa kujjawo era omugugu gujja kuzitowa. Kiba kiseera kya kulekera awo!

Wabula, omugugu bwe guva gy’ali, ojja kulaba enzigi nga zikuggukira mu maaso era obuweereza nga bukula, wadde nga abakulembeze b’ekkanisa yo tebaakola mu buvunaanyizibwa kukusumulula.

Tolina kwongera nsobi yo ku yaabwe ng’ofuuka omuntu eyeekolera yekka awatali kwegatta na balala. Kya nkizo okukuŋŋaanya okukwetooloola Abakristaayo abakuze ab’amagezi abasobola okukuwa okuwabula okulungi era b’oteekwa okwewaayo eri okuvunaanibwa gye bali.

Oyagala amafuta ga Katonda? Kale kikole mu ngeri ya Katonda!

ENKOMERERO.

Ekyongerezeddwako - 1A OKUVUNAANIBWA, OBUYINZA N’OBUVUNAANYIZIBWA

Mu buweereza, obuyinza bwokka obw’amazima bwe tulina buva eri Mukama. SI buyinza obuva mu kifo kyaffe oba ekitiibwa kyaffe naye buyinza obweyoleka mu mafuta gaffe.

Wabula, waliwo obuyinza obusigire nabwo obwetaaga okutegeerwa. Okugeza, omusumba bw’ateekebwako emikono n’ateekebwa ku kibiina, aba n’obuyinza obumusigiddwa abakulembeze b’enzikiriza ye n’abakadde b’ekkanisa abaamwaniriza.

Kino emirundi mingi kireeta okubuusabuusa, kubanga kaakano avunaanibwa ani? Ekifo kye kitera okufuuka ekya bya bufuzi ng’akola ng’omutabaganya wakati w’ekkanisa n’akakiiko akagifuga. Ani gw’akolerera bw’ebyo eby’ekkanisa ey’omu kitundu bwe byesamba n’eby’enzikiriza? Mu mbeera nga eza buli lwe kiba, newaakubadde enzikiriza newaakubadde ekkanisa terina buyinza bumala kuwaliriza musumba kukola kye baagala. Tewali n’omu akakasa ddala oyo gw’avunaanibwa. Kale, entalo bwe zivaayo, abasumba batera okufuuka ab’edda lyabwe, nga bakozesa obuyinza obw’obulimba – nga beekolera bokka!

Lwaki twanguwa nnyo okusaba eddembe lyaffe, obuyinza bwaffe? Oboolyawo tusaanidde okussa essira ku buvunaanyizibwa bwaffe, ku kuvunaanibwa kwaffe, okusinga obuyinza bwaffe. Kubanga byonna byombiryo bisatu byeetaaganya. Tewali buyinza, ka buve eri Katonda oba busigirwe omuntu, awatali buvunaanyizibwa n’okuvunaanibwa. Abakulembeze bangi bakola ensobi ey’okulowooza nti basobola okusigira obuvunaanyizibwa awatali buyinza. Omuntu bw’aweebwa obuvunaanyizibwa, ateekwa bulijjo okuweebwa obuyinza okubutuukiriza, n’amaanyi ag’okusalawo – n’okukola ensobi. Toyinza kusigira buvunaanyizibwa – bulijjo busigala bubwo – naye osobola okusigira obuyinza.

Omusumba alina obuyinza obusigire obuleeta wamu n’obuvunaanyizibwa n’okuvunaanibwa eri abakadde be n’eri District Superintendent we (oba ekyenkanankana nayo). Abakadde be balina obuvunaanyizibwa n’okuvunaanibwa okufaanana eri omusumba waabwe n’eri ekibiina kyabwe.

Okuvunaanibwa kkubo lya njuyi zombi – eri abo abaatuwa obuyinza n’eri abo be twawa obuyinza.

Bw’oba okolera awamu n’abeewaayo, nkola nnungi okukola ekiwandiiko ekitegeerekeka eky’obuyinza obuweereddwa awamu n’okuvunaanibwa n’obuvunaanyizibwa ebigenderako. Okugeza: Endagaano y’Obuweereza (laba Ekyongerezeddwako 2).

Ekyongerezeddwako 1B - EMISINGI GY’OKUSIGIRA OKW’OMUGASO

A. BY’OTOSOBOLA KUSIGIRA 1. Omulimu gwo. N’olwekyo, weetaaga okunnyonnyola obulungi omulimu gwo ggwe.

2. Ggwe wekka by’osobola okukola B. BY’OSAANIDDE OKUSIGIRA 1. By’otosobola kukola.

2. Abalala bye basobola okukola obulungi 3. By’oyigiriza abalala okukola.

4. Ebitali mu bigendererwa byo n’okuyitibwa kwo.

C. EBYESITTAZA MU KUSIGIRA

1. Kakasa nti oyo gw’osigira amanyi nti y’avunaanyizibwa okukola omulimu.

2. Kakasa nti ebiragiro byo bitegeerekeka era nti omulimu gunnyonnyoddwa bulungi.

3. Kakasa nti asobola okukola omulimu, OBA, nti oli mwetegefu okumuleka alemererwe.

4. Kakasa nti omuwadde obuyinza bwonna obwetaagisa, awamu n’obuvunaanyizibwa. (Naye bukyali bubwo!)

5. Gezaako okuteeka ekyetaagisa mu ngeri ya ‘kigendererwa’ ky’asobola okwefunira.

D. AMADAALA G’OKUSIGIRA

- Kitegeeze bulungi.

1. Kikole - so tozzaayo bigambo.

2. Kikole - era ontegeeze kye wakola.

3. Ntegeeza ky’oteekateeka okukola era weeyongereyo okukikola okutuusa lw’onoowulira okuva gye ndi.

4. Ntegeeza ky’oteekateeka okukola, naye toweeyongerayo okutuusa lw’onoowulira okuva gye ndi.

5. Noonyereza ku makubo gonna agaliwo era ompe ekiteeso ku kye kisaanidde okukolebwa.

6. Mpa amawulire gonna agaliwo, nange ndisalawo.

E. ENSONGA EZITERA OKULEMESA OKUSIGIRA

1. Okkiriza nti omuntu tajja kusobola kukwata mulimu ogumuweereddwa.

2. Owulira nga tojja kubeera na budde bwa kuwaayo mulimu n’okuwa okutendeka okwetaagisa.

3. Otya okuvuganya okuva eri omuntu oyo.

4. Otya okufiirwa okumanyibwa.

5. Otya nti obunafu bwo bujja kubikkulwa.

Eric Spruyt YWAM Ekyongerezeddwako 2 - EBYOKULABIRAKO EBY’ENDAGAANO Y’OBUWEEREZA ERI ABAKADDE 1. Eno ye Ndagaano y’Obuweereza gye twakozesa eri ABAKADDE B’EKKANISA YAFFE.

{Ennyanjula: (Kino kyali kiwandiiko ekikwata ku Ssemateeka n’Amateeka ag’ekkanisa ey’omu kitundu n’Ekiwandiiko kyayo eky’Okukkiriza. Mu butonde abakadde bonna bandisuubiddwa okubitegeera n’okubiwagira.)} Ebisaanyizo ebya Bayibuli: Bino bisinga kusangibwa mu 1 Timoseewo 3:1-7 ne Tito 1:5-9.

Twanditegeeredde nti: Kirungi omuntu okwegomba ekifo ng’ekyo. 1 Timoseewo 3:1 Ekifo ng’ekyo ‘kiweebwa Katonda.’ 1 Abakkolinso 12:28 Kisaanidde okutegeerwa omusumba/abakadde abaliwo. 1 Yokaana 4:1 Kikkirizibwa ekibiina (okulonda). 1 Timoseewo 3:7 Bw’ateekebwa mu kifo ky’obukadde, oyo asize omukono akkiriza ebigambo ebiri waggulu n’obuyinza/obuvunaanyizibwa obuddirira nga bwe kwewaayo okw’Endagaano y’Obuweereza.

•Okussa essira lye ery’omwoyo erisooka ku kukula kwe ye n’okutuukiriza emitindo gya Bayibuli egy’obukadde.

•Okufuula obuweereza bwe obw’omwoyo obusooka okuweereza ng’omukadde mu kkanisa eno.

•Okussa ekitiibwa mu kyama ky’Akakiiko k’Abakadde.

•Okutegeera ekifo ky’abakadde abalala n’eddembe lyabwe ery’okutakkiriziganya.

•Okuwagira omusumba mu lujjudde ebbanga lyonna.

•Okuwagira mu lujjudde ebisalwa awamu eby’Akakiiko k’Abakadde.

•Okwatula obutakkiriziganya bwonna ku bikolwa/obuweereza bw’abakadde abalala, eri omukadde oyo yekka butereevu oba mu lukiiko lwa bulijjo olw’Akakiiko k’Abakadde.

•Okwetikka omugugu gw’obuweereza bwe ye n’okukubiriza abalala mu bunyiikivu okwetikka ogwabwe.

•Okulunda abo abali mu buvunaanyizibwa bwe – okunoonya okutabagana we kyetaagisa – okukuuma obumu bw’abakkiriza – okukubiriza okwewaayo eri obuweereza bw’ekkanisa.

•Obutawa kyama we kyandiziyizza Akakiiko k’Abakadde okukola obulungi. Akakiiko k’Abakadde kateekwa okuba n’empuliziganya eya lwatu. Bammemba bwe baba baagala ekyama ng’ekyo, basaanidde okusindikibwa eri omusumba.

•Obutatandika nkiiko zonna nga tobuuzizza dda Akakiiko k’Abakadde.

•Okukolera awamu n’omusumba mu kubuuza n’okukkiriza abaagala okuba bammemba abaggya.

•Okukolera awamu n’Akakiiko k’Abakadde mu kukangavvula bammemba/abagoberezi we kyetaagisa. Kino kiteekwa okugoberera ebiragiro bya Bayibuli. (Omuntu asaanidde okumanya nti okukangavvula omukadde nsonga nzito era kijja kubeera mu lujjudde mu maaso ga bammemba – 1 Timoseewo 5:1,2,19,20) Enkolagana n’Omusumba Olwokubanga baavunaanyizibwa ‘okuyitibwa’ kw’omusumba, Akakiiko k’Abakadde kavunaanyizibwa obulamu bwe n’obuwagizi bwe. Buli mukadde asaanidde okukifuula obuvunaanyizibwa bwe okuzzaamu omusumba amaanyi (n’ab’omu maka ge). Akola kino ng’amuwagira mu lwatu, ng’amusabira, ng’akola ng’omutabaganya wakati we n’ekibiina, ng’akuuma eby’ekyama bye, ennaku ze ez’okuwummula, n’ebirala, ng’ayagala okuweereza era ng’eenyigira mu buweereza bw’ekkanisa.

Enkolagana n’Ekibiina

Obukadde okusinga ‘kuweereza.’ OKUKULEMBERA NG’OWEEREZA kwe kusaanidde okuba ekigendererwa kyaffe, so si kuweereza ng’okulembera.

Awatali kutegeerwa na buwagizi bw’ekibiina (okusingira ddala ku 100%) tewali kifo nga eky’obukadde. Tukwata ekifo kino nga bwe tuba tubalibwa okuba abasaanira okukisitula. Wabula, omuntu asaanidde okukuuma ekifo n’obunyiikivu ebbanga lyonna, si kulwa nga Mukama aggyawo ‘okuyitibwa’ okwo n’akuwa omulala.

Enkolagana n’Abakadde Abalala

“Mu kwagala, nga muwaŋŋana ekitiibwa” (Abaruumi 12:19). Ng’abasajja abaayitibwa awamu mu buvunaanyizibwa, twetaaga okufuba okufuna ‘obumu bw’Omwoyo.’(Laba Abafiripi 2:1-8) Tetusobola kusuubira kkanisa kubeera nga yeegasse, ng’etisse omugugu, ng’eweereddwa omukisa, ng’efaanana Kristo, n’ebirala, okusinga ffe abakadde baayo bwe tuli! Tewali kkanisa esobola okweyongerayo okusukka obukulu bw’abakadde baayo!

Nga nnondeddwa okuba omukadde mu kkanisa ******, nsomye era nkkiriza ekiwandiiko ekiri waggulu n’obuyinza/obuvunaanyizibwa bwakyo.

Ekyongerezeddwako 3 - EBYOKULABIRAKO EBY’ENDAGAANO Y’OBUWEEREZA ERI ABAKULEMBEZE B’ABAVUBUKA

Nga tutegeera: obwetaavu bw’omuvubuka omukulu okukulembera Omulimu gw’Abavubuka mu kkanisa yaffe, nti John Doe alaze omugugu ogw’omulimu ng’ogwo, nti alaze obukakafu obw’okuba nga alina ekirabo eky’omulimu ng’ogwo, ffe, abakadde b’ekkanisa *****, tusumulula John Doe mu buweereza buno, nga tumulonda okuba OMUKULEMBEZE W’ABAVUBUKA omutongole ow’ekibiina kino.

Obuyinza

Ajja kuweebwa obuyinza okusalawo ku bikolwa byonna awamu eby’abavubuka baffe, nga kyetaagisa okutegeeza Akakiiko k’Abakadde mu kiwandiiko nga wakyaliyo waakiri wiiki emu nga ebikolwa tebinnatuuka.

Asobola okuyita abalala okuva ebweru w’ekibiina kyaffe okuweereza abavubuka baffe, nga kyetaagisa okutegeeza Akakiiko k’Abakadde nga tannanyweza nteekateeka n’oyo ‘ow’ebweru,’ okuggyako nga kimanyiddwa nti amaze okukkirizibwa abakadde.

Asobola okukolagana n’abakulembeze b’abavubuka n’abavubuka b’ebibiina ebirala eby’omu kibuga kyaffe, ng’akyakuuma enjigiriza y’ekkanisa eno mu bavubuka baffe.

Asobola okulonda bakozi banne okuva mu kkanisa yaffe, nga kyetaagisa okutegeeza Akakiiko k’Abakadde nga okulonda ng’okwo tekunnanywezebwa.

Ajja kuweebwa enteekateeka ya ssente eya buli mwaka eya $2000, efulumizibwa mu bungi bwa buli mwezi obutasukka $300. Bw’aba ayagala ssente ennyingi ng’ery’omulundi gumu, (okugeza; ng’akakalu k’empeera), ateekwa okusooka okunoonya okukkiriza kw’Akakiiko k’Abakadde.

Obuvunaanyizibwa

Ajja kuwa Akakiiko k’Abakadde alipoota ewandiike ey’ebikolwa byonna eby’Abavubuka omulundi gumu buli myezi esatu. Eno ejja kuba ey’okwekebejja n’ey’okulaga eby’omu maaso. Mu kiseera kino ajja kulaga ebalansi entuufu eya ssente zonna ezaafunibwa n’ezaakozesebwa.

Ajja kunoonya okuleeta okutegeeragana n’okutabagana bwe wabaawo obutakkiriziganya wakati w’abavubuka baffe. Ajja kukola ng’omutabaganya buli lwe wabaawo obutakkiriziganya obwo n’abazadde oba abalala abatali bavubuka.

Ajja kukuza n’okunyweza ebibinja by’Okusoma Bayibuli okw’abavubuka n’Okusaba kw’Abavubuka.

Ajja kunoonya n’obunyiikivu okuyigiriza abavubuka baffe ng’abazzaamu amaanyi kinnoomu mu nkola z’eby’omwoyo.

Ajja kukuza okutegeera ku by’obutume n’okubuulira Enjiri mu bavubuka baffe.

Ateekwa ebbanga lyonna okuba omujulizi omulungi eri Mukama we n’eri ekibiina kino.

Okuvunaanibwa

Ajja kuvunaanibwa yekka eri A.N.Other ng’omukiise w’Akakiiko k’Abakadde.

Endagaano y’Obuweereza eno eneekebejjebwanga buli mwaka ne A.N.Other n’Omusumba.

fields.body_text: Bw’oba weetisse omugugu gw’okkiriza nti guva eri Mukama, naye nga tokyaweereza mu mugugu ogwo, oboolyawo osaanidde okunoonya okusumululwa n’obuwagizi okuva mu kkanisa yo. Nga bw’osomye mu kitabo kino okutuusa kaakano, otandika okutegeera obulumi obwo obuli munda mmwo nga gwe mugugu gwe, era kaakano weebuuza ky’osaanidde okukola ku gwo. Essuula eno ya ggwe. 1. Ekisooka ky’olina okukola kwe kutegeeza obulungi omugugu ogwo. Tekigasa kwogera na balala ku gwo ng’oyinza butabategeeza kye weefaananya era kye mubategeeza. Okugamba nti “Mpulira ennaku nnyingi olw’abamalaaya abali ku nguudo zaffe” tekiraga bulungi obanga olina omugugu gwe ku bo. Otegeeza nti oyagala ab’obuyinza baziyize abamalaaya obutalabikira mu lujjudde? Otegeeza nti toyinza kutambula wakati mu kibuga n’abaana bo akawungeezi? Otegeeza nti okwatibwa ensonyi kubanga mikwano gyo bamanyi ekibuga kyo ng’ekifo omuli abamalaaya? Oba otegeeza nti oyagala okubatuukirira obalage obulamu obusinga obulungi obusangibwa mu Kristo? Ennaku eno, okwegomba kuno, kuyingira mu birowoozo byo ebiseera ebisinga oba kuvaayo kwokka bw’oba oli ‘wakati mu kibuga’? Mu ngeri endala, omugugu guli munda mmwo oba gukujjira kwokka ng’ebiri ebweru bikujjukiza? Omugugu ogw’amazima oguva eri Mukama gujja kufuga ebirowoozo byo, gukumme otulo, era gukukubirize okukola. 2. Weebuuze ebimu ku bibuuzo. “Nkola dda byonna bye nsobola okukola okutuukiriza obwetaavu buno?” Okugeza, bw’oba osanga nga kizibu nnyo okwogera n’abakazi ab’oku nguudo, obuwagizi bw’ekkanisa yo tebugenda kukyanguyiza n’akatono! “Mmanyi nti nnina ebirabo n’obusobozi ebituukira ku buweereza bwe nnoonya?” “Abalala baakakasa ebirabo ebyo mu nze?” “Okusumululwa ekkanisa kwandiyongedde kutya obuweereza bwange okukola obulungi?” “Ekkanisa eweereza dda mu kitundu kino?” Bwe kiba bwe kityo, lwaki toli mu buweereza obwo? Okusumululwa kwo kwandyongedde ku mulimu ogwo oba kwandiguwakanyizza? “Abakulembeze b’ekkanisa yange ab’omwoyo bammanyi bulungi okusobola okutegeera omugugu n’ebirabo byange nga biva eri Mukama?” Tosuubira kusumululwa mu buweereza abakulembeze b’ekkanisa yo bw’oba tonnaba kwekakasa nga oli mwesigwa mu kuweereza munda mu kkanisa, nga weewaddeyo mu kussa ekimu okw’ekkanisa, nga ossaamu ekitiibwa abakulembeze b’ekkanisa era nga otegeera ebirabo eby’omwoyo n’obuweereza bw’abalala. Lwaki abakulembeze b’ekkanisa bandikusumuludde mu buweereza ng’oba tossizza kitiibwa buyinza bwabwe mu bukulembeze? Nabo (basaanidde) okuba n’obuweereza Mukama bwe yabateekerateekera n’abawa n’ebyetaago. Bw’oba totegeera ekyo, lwaki oli mu kkanisa eyo? Nzijukira ekiseera Dawudi kye yamala ng’adduka kabaka Sawulo eyali agudde eddalu. Dawudi yamanya nti Katonda yamufukako amafuta okuba kabaka wa Isirayeri, yali aleeteddwa mu lubiri era ateekwa okuba nga yeewuunya engeri Mukama gye yali ategekamu ekkubo mu maaso ge. Wabula, Sawulo yasigala nga kabaka wadde nga kyali kya lwatu eri bonna nti yali afiiriddwa ekisa kya Katonda era ng’asemberera eddalu. Emirundi ebiri Dawudi yafuna omukisa omwangu ogw’okutta oyo eyali amunoonya, naye buli mulundi n’aziyiza omukono gwe ng’agamba nti, “Wadde omukulembeze wange akola bubi era anoonya okunzikiriza, wadde nga Katonda yampita okuba omukulembeze w’abantu bano, sijja kugolola mukono gwange ku oyo Mukama gwe yalonda!” (Ennukuta ezeewunzikidde zange). Yamanya nti, singa kyali kya Katonda okwagala Dawudi okutwala obwakabaka, yali asobola bulungi okukituukiriza awatali Dawudi kweyingiza! Entalo mmeka mu kkanisa ze zandikomye, ensonyi mmeka ku mubiri gwa Kristo ze zandyewaliddwa, singa twategeera omusingi gwe gumu. Bw’oba tokkiriza nti Mukama ‘yalonda’ omusumba wo mu kifo ky’alimu, lwaki osigala mu kkanisa eyo? Oba ye ‘eyalondebwa’ Katonda ng’aweerereza we Mukama gy’amwagala (wadde ng’akola ensobi era n’atakola byonna by’olowooza nti asaanidde okukola), oba musumba ow’obulimba akubuza! Weegendereze engeri gy’omusalira omusango! 3. Tegeera enteekateeka y’obukulembeze bw’ekkanisa yo. Omanyi ani ‘akubikkako mu by’omwoyo’? Okugeza, mu kkanisa ennene, tekisoboka omusumba omukulu okumanya buli muntu, kale obuweereza obw’obusumba butera okusigirwa abakadde oba abakulembeze b’ebibinja ebitono. Omukadde wo/omukulembeze w’ekibinja ekitono alina obuyinza obumusigiddwa okwogera ku lulwo eri abo abali mu bukulembeze bw’ekkanisa abayinza okukusumulula? Ye kennyini alina obuyinza okukusumulula mu buweereza? Bw’ossa ensonga yo mu maaso ge, yandisobodde okugireeta, awamu naawe, eri abo abakisobola? 4. Wandiika ekiwandiiko ekikwata ku kwolesebwa n’omugugu gwo bwe kityo abakulembeze b’ekkanisa bategeere bulungi bw’owulira. Kino kisaanidde okuweerezebwa oba okuweebwa abakulembeze awamu n’ebbaluwa esaba akakisa okusisinkana nabo. Bw’oba tomanyidde bulungi kweyoleka mu bbaluwa, saba mukwano gwo ow’amagezi asome ebiwandiiko era akuwe amagezi ku bye birimu. Ekiwandiiko kisaanidde era okulimu ebiteeso ku ngeri obuweereza gye buyinza okubaamu. Oyinza okwagala okuteekamu koppi y’ekitabo kino bwe kityo abakulembeze bategeere w’oggya ebirowoozo byo! Eri bangi ku bo, kino kyandibadde ekkubo eppya kubanga tebabaddewo kulowooza ku buvunaanyizibwa bwabwe ‘okutendeka abantu ba Katonda olw’omulimu ogw’obuweereza’. Tebabangako kulowooza ku kukusumulula obuuke ng’empungu. Baayigirizibwa nti omulimu gw’obuweereza gwa basumba abaateekebwako emikono bokka. Nga kya nnaku! Nga tekigoberera Byawandiikibwa! 5. Noonya okukolera awamu n’abakulembeze b’ekkanisa yo mu kukuza obuweereza bwo ng’ovunaanibwa. Olwokubanga okkiriza okuvunaanibwa eri abo Mukama be yateeka mu Mubiri gwa Kristo okuba abakutendeka, olwo n’asobola okukuwa obuyinza obw’amafuta ge. Jjukira nti okuvunaanibwa kitegeeza okuba omwetegefu okukkiriza eky’okuddamu ekigamba ‘Nedda’ nga bw’okkiriza ‘Weewaawo’! Abakulembeze bo bayinza okuba nga bakola mu buvunaanyizibwa nnyo bwe bagamba ‘Nedda’ ku kusaba kwo kubanga bakkiriza nti tonnaba kubeera mwetegefu kusumululwa. Okyalina okwekakasa nga oli mwesigwa mu bintu ebitono, nga tosagaasagana mu kigendererwa, ng’olaga empisa n’ebirabo ebyetaagisa. Tebajja kukusindika kukuggya mu kiswa bwe balaba nga okyalina ebiwundu n’endowooza ebyandiziyizza okubuuka kwo! Bwe kiba nga abakulembeze b’ekkanisa yo tebakkiriza buvunaanyizibwa bw’okutendeka n’okusumulula, lwe kyokka lw’oba oli waddembe okutwala omutendera 6! 6. Fuluma mu kiswa! Awatali buwagizi bwa kkanisa yo, kino kiyinza okutiisa. Omugugu gwo bwe guba nga teguva eri Mukama, ojja kukoowa era n’oterebuka ng’olwanirira mu maanyi go bwe wekka okukozesa obuweereza buno. Ojja kukemebwa okukozesa enkola ez’ensi okufuna ‘obuwanguzi’ era okwekengera kujja kukuggyako essanyu ery’okuweereza. Ssente z’olowooza nti nzeetaagisa tezijja kwanguyirwa kujjawo era omugugu gujja kuzitowa. Kiba kiseera kya kulekera awo! Wabula, omugugu bwe guva gy’ali, ojja kulaba enzigi nga zikuggukira mu maaso era obuweereza nga bukula, wadde nga abakulembeze b’ekkanisa yo tebaakola mu buvunaanyizibwa kukusumulula. Tolina kwongera nsobi yo ku yaabwe ng’ofuuka omuntu eyeekolera yekka awatali kwegatta na balala. Kya nkizo okukuŋŋaanya okukwetooloola Abakristaayo abakuze ab’amagezi abasobola okukuwa okuwabula okulungi era b’oteekwa okwewaayo eri okuvunaanibwa gye bali. Oyagala amafuta ga Katonda? Kale kikole mu ngeri ya Katonda! ENKOMERERO. Ekyongerezeddwako - 1A OKUVUNAANIBWA, OBUYINZA N’OBUVUNAANYIZIBWA Mu buweereza, obuyinza bwokka obw’amazima bwe tulina buva eri Mukama. SI buyinza obuva mu kifo kyaffe oba ekitiibwa kyaffe naye buyinza obweyoleka mu mafuta gaffe. Wabula, waliwo obuyinza obusigire nabwo obwetaaga okutegeerwa. Okugeza, omusumba bw’ateekebwako emikono n’ateekebwa ku kibiina, aba n’obuyinza obumusigiddwa abakulembeze b’enzikiriza ye n’abakadde b’ekkanisa abaamwaniriza. Kino emirundi mingi kireeta okubuusabuusa, kubanga kaakano avunaanibwa ani? Ekifo kye kitera okufuuka ekya bya bufuzi ng’akola ng’omutabaganya wakati w’ekkanisa n’akakiiko akagifuga. Ani gw’akolerera bw’ebyo eby’ekkanisa ey’omu kitundu bwe byesamba n’eby’enzikiriza? Mu mbeera nga eza buli lwe kiba, newaakubadde enzikiriza newaakubadde ekkanisa terina buyinza bumala kuwaliriza musumba kukola kye baagala. Tewali n’omu akakasa ddala oyo gw’avunaanibwa. Kale, entalo bwe zivaayo, abasumba batera okufuuka ab’edda lyabwe, nga bakozesa obuyinza obw’obulimba – nga beekolera bokka! Lwaki twanguwa nnyo okusaba eddembe lyaffe, obuyinza bwaffe? Oboolyawo tusaanidde okussa essira ku buvunaanyizibwa bwaffe, ku kuvunaanibwa kwaffe, okusinga obuyinza bwaffe. Kubanga byonna byombiryo bisatu byeetaaganya. Tewali buyinza, ka buve eri Katonda oba busigirwe omuntu, awatali buvunaanyizibwa n’okuvunaanibwa. Abakulembeze bangi bakola ensobi ey’okulowooza nti basobola okusigira obuvunaanyizibwa awatali buyinza. Omuntu bw’aweebwa obuvunaanyizibwa, ateekwa bulijjo okuweebwa obuyinza okubutuukiriza, n’amaanyi ag’okusalawo – n’okukola ensobi. Toyinza kusigira buvunaanyizibwa – bulijjo busigala bubwo – naye osobola okusigira obuyinza. Omusumba alina obuyinza obusigire obuleeta wamu n’obuvunaanyizibwa n’okuvunaanibwa eri abakadde be n’eri District Superintendent we (oba ekyenkanankana nayo). Abakadde be balina obuvunaanyizibwa n’okuvunaanibwa okufaanana eri omusumba waabwe n’eri ekibiina kyabwe. Okuvunaanibwa kkubo lya njuyi zombi – eri abo abaatuwa obuyinza n’eri abo be twawa obuyinza. Bw’oba okolera awamu n’abeewaayo, nkola nnungi okukola ekiwandiiko ekitegeerekeka eky’obuyinza obuweereddwa awamu n’okuvunaanibwa n’obuvunaanyizibwa ebigenderako. Akakiiko k’Abakadde kateekwa okuba n’empuliziganya eya lwatu. Bammemba bwe baba baagala ekyama ng’ekyo, basaanidde okusindikibwa eri omusumba. •Obutatandika nkiiko zonna nga tobuuzizza dda Akakiiko k’Abakadde. •Okukolera awamu n’omusumba mu kubuuza n’okukkiriza abaagala okuba bammemba abaggya. •Okukolera awamu n’Akakiiko k’Abakadde mu kukangavvula bammemba/abagoberezi we kyetaagisa. Kino kiteekwa okugoberera ebiragiro bya Bayibuli. (Omuntu asaanidde okumanya nti okukangavvula omukadde nsonga nzito era kijja kubeera mu lujjudde mu maaso ga bammemba – 1 Timoseewo 5:1,2,19,20) Enkolagana n’Omusumba Olwokubanga baavunaanyizibwa ‘okuyitibwa’ kw’omusumba, Akakiiko k’Abakadde kavunaanyizibwa obulamu bwe n’obuwagizi bwe. Buli mukadde asaanidde okukifuula obuvunaanyizibwa bwe okuzzaamu omusumba amaanyi (n’ab’omu maka ge). Akola kino ng’amuwagira mu lwatu, ng’amusabira, ng’akola ng’omutabaganya wakati we n’ekibiina, ng’akuuma eby’ekyama bye, ennaku ze ez’okuwummula, n’ebirala, ng’ayagala okuweereza era ng’eenyigira mu buweereza bw’ekkanisa. Enkolagana n’Ekibiina Obukadde okusinga ‘kuweereza.’ OKUKULEMBERA NG’OWEEREZA kwe kusaanidde okuba ekigendererwa kyaffe, so si kuweereza ng’okulembera. Awatali kutegeerwa na buwagizi bw’ekibiina (okusingira ddala ku 100%) tewali kifo nga eky’obukadde. Tukwata ekifo kino nga bwe tuba tubalibwa okuba abasaanira okukisitula. Wabula, omuntu asaanidde okukuuma ekifo n’obunyiikivu ebbanga lyonna, si kulwa nga Mukama aggyawo ‘okuyitibwa’ okwo n’akuwa omulala. Enkolagana n’Abakadde Abalala “Mu kwagala, nga muwaŋŋana ekitiibwa” (Abaruumi 12:19).
